. MEENYA ngyiramá apem matow ndwom

Makamfo me Hen N'enyimnyam,

. Mo Wùra dɔyɛfo, me Nyankopon,
Boa m' ma mombɔ dawur,

. Jesus! dzin a otu hen suro,

. Ɔkasa, na wotsie Ne ndze a,

. Odwuruw bᴐn no tum koraa,

. NYIMPA a hom wᴐ wiadze nyina,

. WI n‘ase a ɔno dze nyina

. Nyame, W’ehumbɔbɔr tsim daa;

Hallelujah!
W‘ayɛyi bɛgyegye mbea nyina,

. DOMANKOMA ! Wo sor tsebea
Yɛ fɛw dɛ mbrɛ osɛ Nyame:
Ɔtra wimuwimu n'ekyir noho.
Mbrɛ nworaba wɔkɔ aprɔw.

. Bɔfopanyin rotow W'Ndwom a.
N'enyim suma n'atsaban mu;
Ahotsewfo a woetwa ehyia.
Bom famu wɔ hɔ nyina som Wo.

. Nyame, dɛtse na nso nyɛ dɛn?
Hɛn so yɛbɔsom hen Bɔfo:
Yefi bɔn na huntuma m'frɛ Wo
Kɛse, Kronkronyi, Abɔso.

. Wɔatse Wo nka wɔ ekyirkyir,
Mbɔtoaba esua Wo dzin bɔ;
Na Wo nyansaa N'enyimnyam no
Ma hen adwen nyina tɔ sin.

. Hom ntow No tum nye N'adom so ho ndwom:
N'atar nye ekan, No buw pretetee;
N'ebufuw tseaseanam hye senaman fua tum,
No kwan yɛ sum wɔ ehum atsaban do.

. Asaase nye N'anwanwadze a wɔnnka:
Otumfo! Wo tum bɔɔ adze fi tsetse;
Nam 'mom a wɔnndan n' da etsim no pintsinn,
Na edze epo abᴐ no ho abᴐmprᴐw.

. W'ayamúyie no gyirama hɛn botúm aká?
Ogú ahom wɛ wimú, ɔhyerɛn kan mu;
Ofi akoko do pem siansian sar mu,
Na ɔsɔw fénemfénem wɔ bɔw nye
nyankom mu.

. Huntuma m' mbá a yɛnnkye so yɛyɛ mbérɛw,
Hɛn wérɛ hyɛ Wo mu, W'ayamúyie
mmpada;
Mbrɛ W'adom dua gow a otsim hɔ dú ewiei,
Hɛn Bɔfo, hɛn Gyefo, Pomfo na Dɔfo!

. Tum a wonnsusu! Dɔ a onnyi kabea!
Mbér a abɔfo dzé enyigye tow ndwom no,
Abɔdzé adedafamú so nam hɛn mbérɛwyɛ m'
Bɔtonton Wo atow ndwom eyi W' ayaw!
Amen.

. O SƆR Ewuradze wɔ krɔnkrɔnyɛ fɛɛfɛw mu
Kotow N'enyim, bɔ N'enyimnyam dawur;
Fa setsie mapa ɔnye mbrɛhoadze huanhuam,
Kotow huhor No, Ne dzin nye Ewuradze.

. Fa w'adwendwen adzesoa to N'ananadze,
Ɔbɔsoa ama wo wɔ N'akoma mu,
Ɔbɛkyekye wo werɛ, na oetsie wo mpaabɔ,
Na oegya w' taataa dɛ.mbrɛ oye ma w'.

. Mma nnsuro dɛ ebɛhɛn N'abangua do hɔ,
Dɛ ahodze a ewɔ no suar ntsi:
Afɔrbɔdze a wɔdze gu N'afɔrmbukyia do
Nye nokwar fɛɛfɛw na ɔdɔ mapa.

. Yinom, sɛ yɛdze ba suro na ahopopo m' mpo a,
Ɔbɛgye wɔ dzin a ɔsorn bo no ntsi;
Ɔbɛpepa hɛn nyinsu, ɔama yeedzi dɛw,
Oetu hɛn suro, ɔarna hɛn awerɛhyɛm'.

. O sɔr Ewuradze wɔ krɔnkrɔnyɛ fɛɛfɛw mu!
Kotow N'enyim, bɔ N'enyimnyam dawur;
Fa setsie mapa ɔnye mbrɛhoadze huanhuam,
Kotow huhor No, Ne dzin nye Ewuradze.
Amen.

. HƐN akoma, nsa nye ndze
Yɛdze da nyame ase;
Ɔayɛ anwanwadze,
Wiadze dzi ho ehurusi;
Ofi hɛn na ne yamu,
Ɔdze dɔ akyɛ dze
Ehyira hɛen kwan nyina m',
Na ɔda ho yɛ hɛndze.

. Ɔkyɛso Nyankopɔn
Ɔnka hɛn ho daa nyina,
Ɔmfa ahotɔ krɔnn,
Ɔndom hɛn akoma daa,
Ɔnkora hɛn N'adom mu,
Ongya hɛn nkɔntɔnkye m',
Na ɔmpa hɛn mbusu,
Sesei na ndaamba so.

. Me kra, yi ɔsor hen ayɛw,
Fa w' ayɛdze bra N' enyim;
Ɔapon wo, dze wo bɔn akyɛ w',
Woana mbɔ nyi No ayɛw?
Yi No ayɛw!
Yi bɛkyebo Hen ayɛw.

. Yi N' ayɛw, Nadom na enyimpa
Hwɛɛ egyanom ahohiam';
Yi No ayɛw, ɔnnsakyer da,
Ɔka enyim nyaa, ohyira ntsɛm:
Yi No ayɛw!
Nyimnyamfo wɔ nokwardzim'.

. Wonyi Nyame Hen ayɛw!
Wɔmfa ayɛyindwom mbrɛ N';
N' ehumbɔbor tsim hɔ daa,
Osi pi yɛ nokwar daa.

. Wonyi N' ayɛw: ɔayὲ ewia,
Dὲ ɔkɔ aprɔw daa daa nyina:
N' ehumbɔbor tsim hɔ daa,
Osi pi yɛ nokwar daa.

. Na eso ɔayɛ bosoom,
Ma odu anafua a ɔhyerɛn:
N' ehumbɔbor tsim hɔ daa,
Osi pi yɛ nokwar daa.

. Wonhyira N' dὲ ɔtɔ nyankom,
Ma ɔma edziban fifir:
N' ehumbɔbor tsim hɔ daa,
Osi pi yɛ nokwar daa.

. Na ɔma asaase pa so
Oyi no ndɔbaa ma hɛn:
N' ehumbɔbor tsim hɔ daa,
Osi pi yɛ nokwar daa.

. Ɔama buber so aba,
Ɔahyɛ hɛn asan mama:
N' ehumbɔbor tsim hɔ daa,
Osi pi yɛ nokwar daa.

. Ɔama edziban a ɔsen dɛm,
Daa daa dɛw ho ahobadze:
N' ehumbɔbor tsim hɔ daa,
Osi pi yɛ nokwar daa.

. Enyimnyam nka, Hen dɔyɛfo
Abɔdze nyina ntow enyimnyam,
Enyimnyam nka Egya, nye Ba,
Nye Sunsum, Ebiasa Kor. Amen.

. NYIMNYAN HEN, Asomdwee Hen,
Mobɔdɔ Wo;
Na dɔ no rommbɔ adze da,
Meserɛ Wo.
Ɔwo ama m' m'ebisadze,
Ɔwo etsie me;
Ɔwo hun mbrɛ mo bɔn tse,
Dze mo ho akyɛ m'.

. Medze me nyimdzee mapa
M'bɔtow Wo ndwom,
M'akoma m' ndzepa nyina
Medze bɛma W'.
Kaansa mo bɔn kaa m'tsiaa m' mpo a,
Esaan mo ho;
Wɔpraa ano guu mo do no,
Ɔwo 'tsiee me.

. Hɛn Nyame N' abɔdze nyina,
Hom mma hom ndze do nye hɛn ntow
Alleluia, Alleluia!
Ewia hyeehyew, 'hyerɛn dɛ sika,
Bosoom nwinwin, 'tse dɛ dwetε,
Yi N' ayɛw, yi N' ayɛw
Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia!

. M-frama a itu ehum dzendzen,
Esuwusiw a esen wimu,
Yi N' ayɛw, Alleluia!
Bosoom, fa enyigye yi N' ayɛw,
N-woraba, hom mbɔ hom ndzem'
Yi N' ayɛw, yi N' ayɛw
Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia!

. N-su krɔngyenn a erepem,
Tow ndwom ma w' Ewuradze ntse,
Alleluia, Alleluia!
Ogya hurenhuren a eyɛ dzen,
'Wo a ema nyimpa hyew na kan,
Yi N' ayɛw, yi N' ayɛw
Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia!

. Asaase pa a Nyame ama
Daa daa iyi siar ma ne mba,
Yi N' ayɛw, Alleluia!
Wo mu nhyiren nye nduaba so,
Womfifir nkyerɛ N' enyimnyam,
Yi N' ayɛw, yi N' ayɛw
Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia!

. N-korɔfo a hom 'koma dwe nyina,
Na hom dze bɔn kyɛ, hom so mbra,
Hom so ntow Alleluia!
Amandzehufo, 'werɛhofo,
Hom nyi N' ayɛw, mfa ne nyina nsoa N',
Yi N' ayɛw, yi N' ayɛw
Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia!

. Ao, Owu, yamuyiefo a edwe,
'Wo a itwa hɛn owu ngyam do,
Yi N' ayɛw, Alleluia!
'Wo na 'dze Nyame mba kɔ fie,
Hɛn Wura Christ faa wo kwan n' mu:
Yi N' ayɛw, yi N' ayɛw
Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia!

. Krɔnkrɔn, krɔnkrɔn, krɔnkrɔn, Otumfo Nyankopɔn!
Hɛn ndwom bɔfow edu Wo nkyɛn anapahema;
Krɔnkrɔn, krɔnkrɔn, krɔnkrɔn, mbɔbɔrhufo, tumfo,
Nyame Baasa Kor, Ɔkorsa siarfo!

. Krɔnkrɔn, krɔnkrɔn, krɔnkrɔn, ahotsewfo sɔr Wo,
Wɔtow hɔn sika nhenkyɛw gu ahwehwɛ po n' ho;
Cherubim nye Seraphim twa hwe W' enyim ara,
'Wo a obi annyɛ Wo, na itsim hɔ daa.

. Krɔnkrɔn, krɔnkrɔn, krɔnkrɔn; sɛ sum dze Wo suma,
Na dasanyi a omuo hu W' enyim a ɔnnyɛ mpo a
Wo nko na yɛ krɔnkrɔn, obi nnka Wo ho bio,
Wo tum, Wo dɔ, Wo krɔnkrɔnyɛ dzi mu!

. Krɔnkrɔn, krɔnkrɔn, krɔnkrɔn, Otumfo Nyankopɔn!
W' edwinsa beyi Wo dzin ayɛw wɔ mbea nyina;
Krɔnkrɔn, krɔnkrɔn, krɔnkrɔn, mbɔbɔrhufo, tumfo,
Nyame Baasa Kor, Ɔkorsa siarfo! Amen.

. Ɔsor Egya a Wo dɔ kɛse n'
Abɔ werdam ama hɛn kra,
Abɔn yɛkotow W' egua enyim;
Wo bɔnfakyɛ dɔ n' fa dom hɛn.

. Ba Tumfo, Asɛm a ɔbrae,
Hɛn Nkɔnhyɛnyi, Sɔfo, Pomfo,
Abɔn yɛkotow W' egua enyim;
Wo nkwagye adom n', fa dom hɛn.

. Sunsum Bɛkyebo a W' ahom ma
Wɔgye kra fi bɔn nsa na wum',
Abɔn yɛkotow W' egua enyim;
Wo nkwahwea tum no, fa dom hɛn.

. Ewuradze nye mo Guanhwɛfo,
Biribiara nnkehia m';
Ɔma meda mfunoma mu,
Ogya m' kɔ nsutaae ho.

. Ɔdze me kra san ba nkwam' bio,
Na ɔma menantsew
Ne ndzeyɛtsenenee kwan no mu,
Wɔ Noara Ne dzin ntsi.

. Nyew, sɛ menam wu bɔnsam' a,
Munnsuro mbusu biara;
Osiandɛ 'nye m' nam, Wo poma
Na W' abaw hyɛ me dzen.

. Hwɛ, bɔw mpѐtsema hyɛnhyɛnn
Sosɔ nhaban do;
Ber, a wɔrehyѐrɛn, wɔkyѐrɛ
Dɛ, Nyame ye daa.

. Hwɛ ''napa wi nsѐrɛmɛn,
Ͻsesa kwaa mu,
Dzinn, naaso wɔrekã
''Dɛ, Nyame ye daa.

. Tsie koko n'' woraba,
No nko da hɔ no,
Eminim à ɔrobɔ n' kã
Dɛ, Nyame ye daa.

. Dua no sor nhaban mu,
Mbrɛ suro bi nnyi n',
Nnoma rotow ndwom kyѐrɛ
Dɛ, Nyame ye daa.

. Ayɛyi nka Ewuradze a otu w' edwuma
mpon, weɔn wo,
Ampaara Ne yie nye N' adom ka wo do daa wɔ ha:
Dwen ho bio hwɛ
Dza Otumfo No tum yɛ,
Sɛ ɔdze No dɔ fa w' nyɛnko a.

. Ayɛyi nka Ewuradze, ɔno a ehumtuber no mu,
Ɔno na ber a abɔdze nyina etwa ayer wo no,
Ɔma wogyaa,
Begyabegyayɛ taa dzinn,
Ɔma ehum na po yɛ komm n'.

. Ayɛyi nka Ewuradze, ɔno a ber a bɔn na sum agye,
Ɔno na abosonsɔrfo dzi nyim mmbu papayɛ bi a
Ne kan hyerɛn,
Pam sum mu ewurkadze,
N' adom bɔ esiarfo ho ban.

. Oyi nye Nyame a yɛsɔr No n',
Hɛn Dɔfo pa a ɔnnsakyer da n',
No dɔ so dɛ No tum kɛse n',
Onnyi mbanano, nnyi ewiei.

. Me Nyame, mbrɛ 'dua yɛ nwanwa a
W' ahentum ne hyerɛn a!
Wo mbɔbɔrhu egua n' ne fɛw a
Wɔ kan a ɔhyerɛn mu!

. Wo mfe a ɔmmbɔ adze n' no hu a,
Domankoma Ewuradze,
Esunsum wotwa hwe W' enyim
Tonton Wo daa nyina.

. Mbrɛ odua yɛ fɛw, yɛ fɛw a,
Dɛ yebohu W' enyim
Wo nyansaa bun n', Wo tum kɛse n'
Nyame W' ahotsew nwanwa.

. Ao Nyame, mbrɛ misi suro Wo a,
Suro a no mu dɔ,
Na medze ahopopo enyidar,
Nnuhu nyinsu som Wo!

. Ma mo so maadɔ W', Ewuradze,
Ɔwo a 'yɛ Tumfo yi,
Abɔ Wo mu adze ebisa
M' akoma brɛfo no dɔ.

. Egya bi nnyɛ dɔ dɛ Ɔwo;
Na bi nndwe dɛ Ɔwo,
Wonnyi abotar dɛ mbrɛ ewɔ n'
Emi babɔn yi ho.

. Ɔdɔ Hen nye mo Guanhwɛfo,
N' ayamuyie mmpa ara da;
Meyɛ Nedze ma ɔyɛ medze aba,
Mirinnhia hweeara da.

. Mbrɛ nkwa esutsen fi pem no,
Hɔ na ogya me kra kɔ,
Ɔdze sor edziban nyɛn me
Wɔ mbrɛ m-funoma wɔ no.

. M-ber pii na mikyiin bɔn mu,
Na ɔdze dɔ hwehwɛɛ me;
Ɔdze me too Ne batsir do
Dze me baa fie edɛw mu.

. Owu bɔnsam' munnsuro mbusu,
Ber a, mo Wura, ebɛn me;
W' abaw na Wo poma hyɛ m' dzen,
Na Woara idzi m' enyim.

. Minsi dɛn mondɔ me Nyame,
Minsi dɛn nyi N' ayɛw?
Minsi dɛn nhu N' adom no war,
Ne trɛ, no krɔn, no bun?

. Odu wiadze tɛtɛr nyina,
Ne trɛ nnyi mbanano;
Ɔtrɛ ma onngya baako mpo,
N-kyɛ ɔpaa mo ho.

. Sor abɔfo bɛn botum akyerɛ
Wo nkwagye dɔ n' no bun?
W' akyɛdze a onnyi kabea yi,
Ao, ma monsɔ monhwɛ.

. Enyimnyam nye ntonton nka
Wo, hɛn Hen Agyenkwa,
Ɔwo a mbofra ndze dɛɛdɛw,
Toow Hosanna maa Wo!

. Ɔwo nye Israel Hen,
Ɔhen David ne Ba a
Enam Ewuradze dzin mu
Reba dɛ hɛn siar Hen.
Enyimnyam nye¬—

. Abɔfo dɔm nyinara
Kamfo Wo Nyame manm':
Nyimpa nye abɔdze nyina
Bɔ ose gye hɔn do.
Enyimnyam nye¬—

. Hebrewman mu nkorɔfo dze
Mberɛnkɔnson huaa Wo;
Hɛn so yɛdze ayɛyi
Nye mpaabɔ ba W' enyim.
Enyimnyam nye¬—

. Irikehyia mbusu no,
Wɔtoow ndwom yii W' ayɛw;
N- dɛ a wɔakrɔn Wo sor yi,
Hɛn so yehuhor Wo.
Enyimnyam nye¬—

. Egyee Jewfo ayɛyi;
Gye hɛn so hɛn mpaabɔ,
Ɔhen dɔyɛfo, yamuyiefo a
Ndzepa nyina yɛ W' fɛw.
Enyimnyam nye¬—

. 'Sɛmpa n' ho atɔfo, hom nhua N'
Wɔ N' afɔrmbukyia n' do;
Hom nhua nyia hom tsia N' anamɔnm'
Na hom nhyɛ N' abɔso Hen.

. Israel mbasantsen, hom a
Woeyi hom asehwem',
Hom nhua nyia ɔdze N' adom gye hom n',
Na hom nhyɛ N' abɔso Hen.

. Bɔnyɛfo, mma hom werɛ mmfir
Bɔwen na bɔwema n';
Hom mfa hom asadze nkɔ nkɛma N',
Na hom nhyɛ N' abɔso Hen.

. Ebusua na ngyirama nyina,
Wontwa nhwehwe N' enyim;
Na hɔn nyina wɔntow ndwom nhua
Nyia wɔahyɛ N' abɔso Hen.

. Jesus dzin bɔ adze nyina do,
Wɔ hɛll, nye ase, nye sor,
Abɔfo na nyimpa kotow n',
Na mbɔnsam fi enyim guan.

. Jesus! dzin a ɔyɛ abɔn dɛw,
Dzin a wɔdze akyɛ abɔn;
Ɔhotse hɔn suro nyina,
Na ɔdan hɔn hɛll yɛ heaven.

. Jesus! otu adaduafo apo,
Otsia abɔnsam tsir do;
Ɔdze tum hyɛ nyia onnyi ahom,
Na ɔma ewufo nkwa.

. Ao, nkyɛ N' adom ahonya no
Wiadze nyina aasɔ ahwɛ!
N-kyɛ No dɔ abaw n' bofua
Adasamba nyina.

. Ne tsenenee na No nkwagye
Na mobɔ no dawur,
M' edwuma nye dɛ mekam' dɛ,
Wɔnhwɛ Eguambaa no!

. Eguambaa bi, nkwagye dzin bi,
Enyidar bi nnyi sor anaa ase,
Fɔdzi nye fɛr ho guansumabew bi nnyi,
Dɛ Wo nkotoo.

. Me gyedzi suar, m' enyidar suar,
M' akoma ne hia nye no mbusu nko
Na ɔbɔ mu dɛ senaman wɔ mo mu
Kekam' frɛ Wo.

. Mbrɛ Jesus ne dzin dua yɛ dɛw
Wɔ gyedzinyi asom' a!
Otu ne ya, yɛ ne yar edur,
Na otu no suro nyina.

. Ɔbɔ sunsum a oepira esu,
Na ɔdwe akoma a ɔahaw,
Edziban ma sunsum a kɔm dze n',
Ahomgye ma fonafo.

. Dzin pa! Botan a motow do,
Me kyɛm na mo sumabew,
M' egyapadze a ɔmmpa da,
Adom na ɔahyɛ n' ma!

. Jesus, mo Guanhwɛfo, mo Nua
Mo Sɔfoe na me Hen,
Mo Wura , mo Nkwa, mo Kwan, m' Ewiei,
Bra bɛgye m' ayɛyi.

. Mo mbɔdzembɔ ɔyɛ mberɛw,
M' akoma yɛ wɔɔwɔw;
Na ber a m' bohu W' dɛ mbrɛ Ɔwo tse n',
M' beyi W' ayɛw dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ.

. Pomfo kɛse, Nyame Eguambaa,
Yɛdɔ Wo ho n-sɛm;
Ndwom biara nnyi hɔ a ɔyɛ dɛw
Dɛ Wo dzin nwanwa no.

. Ber a yɛwɔ wiadze mu yi,
Jesus nye hɛn nkɔmbɔ:
Na ndzɛmba nyina so sɛɛ a
Jesus bɛyɛ hɛ ndwom.

. Jesus, Wo ho adwen nko mpo
Dze dɛw hyɛ mo mu ma;
Na meba m' bohu W' enyim dze a,
Edɛw no bɔbor do.

. O adasa hɛn Agyenkwa,
Dzin biara nnto Wodze a
Yɛdze enyigye bɔtow ho ndwom,
Na yɛadwen ho dɔ mu.

. O 'koma bobɔe n' Enyidar,
Abrɛfo Enyigye,
Iye ma asehwefo na
Hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ Wo.

. Na hɔn a wohu Wo nka dɛn?
Wonnhu dza wɔnka mpo:
Hɔn a wɔtse Wo dɔ nko ara
Na wonyim ne dɛw no.

. Jesus, 'koma dɔyɛfo hɔn Dɛw,
Adasa Kan, nkwa Nsunyiwa,
Wiadze mu ndzepa nntum mmee hɛn,
Yɛdze kɔm yɛdan ba Wo hɔ.

. Yɛsɔ Wo hwɛ, n-kwa Edziban,
Na hɛn kɔn dɔ yeedzi bi daa;
Yɛnom Wo, n-kwa Esutsen,
Na hɛn kra pɛ ma wɔaahyɛ n' ma.

. Hɛn sunsum haahaa hwehwɛ Wo,
Mbrɛ ɔbra dze hɛn si biara,
Eyaa W' ano hɛn enyi gye,
Yesuo Wom' a siar aka hɛn.

. Jesus, me kra no Dɔfo,
Ma munguan mbɛhyɛ Wo bom',
Ber a esu no repem yi,
Ber a ehum no rutu yi,
Me Gyefo, fa me hunta,
Ma ehum no mbɔ mbɛsen;
Gya me kodu berano,
Ao, ewiei no gye me kra.

. Minnyi sumabew biara,
Me kra twer Wo nkotonoo;
Mma nndan mo nkotonoo nngya,
Suo mo mu, kyekye mo werɛ:
Mo werɛ gyina Wo do,
Mo mboa nyina fir wo hɔ;
Fa W' atsaban kɛse no
Kata m' etsikwa yi do.

. Christ, morohwehwɛ Wo nko,
Minya W' a menya adze nyina,
Ma mo do si, hyɛ me dzen,
Yɛ m' edur na gye me nkwa:
'Wo na eyɛ tseneneenyi,
'Midze, meyɛ brakyewnyi;
Bɔn na ahyɛ emi ma,
Adom ahyɛ wo so ma.

. Jesus, hɛn Guanhwɛfo,
Pepa hɛn nyinsuwa;
Sɛ yɛda no bom' a,
Yennsuro biribiara.
Wɔmma yɛnka No do
Mbrɛ ɔbɛkyerɛ biara,
Yɛnka no do sar do na
"Saase pa do

. Jesus, hɛn Guanhwɛfo,
Ne ndze yɛ hɛn dɛw;
Ɔwasa kakra ara a
Nna hɛn enyim mpo a,
Ne ndze n' odo wɔm';
Yɛmmpɛ kwankyerɛfo biara
Dɛ No nkotoo.

. Jesus, hɛn Guanhwɛfo,
No nguan ntsi owui;
No bɔgyaa enuma
No nguambaa nyina.
Ɔwo dza odze hyɛ
Hɔn mu biara nsew,
Hɔn a woyɛ Nedze no
Wɔ no Sunsum.

. Jesus, hɛn Guanhwɛfo,
N'abaw weɔn hɛn daa;
Ngyata kyin hɛn ho mpo a,
Hɔn nsa nnkaka hɛn.
Owu bɔnsa mu hɔ,
Sum huhu hyɛ mpo a,
Yennsuro mbusu biara
Yɛka wu hyɛ.

. MBRƐ mudua dɔ Jesus,
Osiandɛ odzii kan dɔɔ m'.

. Mo werɛ nnkefir N' da,
Ɔno owui maa me.

. Metse mema Jesus:
Ɔdze No nkwa maa me.

. Jesus siarfo, kὸra me:
Motwer Wo dzin nkotoo.

. Ao, Jesus, m' bɔdɔ Wo:
M' bɔdɔ W' akɔ owum'.

. Tsie! abɔfo ruhua dɛ
Wɔawo hɛn Hen nyimnyamfo n',
Asaase wɔ asomdwee,
Nyame na abɔn abɔm'.
Aman nyina, hom mfa dɛw
Nye sor abɔfo ntseatseam'
Hom nye hɔn mbɔm mpaa mu dɛ,
Wɔawo Christ wɔ Bethlehem.
Tsie! abɔfo ruhua dɛ
Wɔawo hɛn Hen nyimnyamfo n',

. Christ a sorsor tonton No,
Ɔdomankoma Ewuradze n',
Hwɛ N', ɔkyɛree mpo a ɔaba.
Ɔbaabun wotoam' ɔba!
Hwɛ, Nyame hyɛ nyimpadua!
Nyame a wɔayɛ N' onyimpa!
Ɔpɛ dɛ ɔnye nyimpa tsena,
Jesus, hɛn Immanuel.

. Agyedzifo, hom mbra
Dɛw na konyimdzi mu,
Hom mbra, O hom nyina mbra Bethlehem;
Hom mbra mbɔhwɛ dɛ
Wɔawo abɔfo Hen:
O hom mbra mma yɛntonton Ewuradze Christ.

. Abɔfo, hom ntow
Ndwom ehurusi mu,
Sor ahemfiemba nyina ntow ndwom
Dɛ, Enyimnyam nyina
Nka Nyame wɔ sorsor:
O hom mbra mma yɛntonton Ewuradze Christ.

. N-guanhwɛfo a wɔroweɔn hɔn nguan no
Tsee bɔfo huafo ne ndze dɛ ɔse:
Hwɛ, medze Agyenkwa N' awoo ho nsɛm
Bɔ hom na wiadze nyina amandzɛɛ;
N-dɛ Nyame apon N' anohoba,
Wɔawo Ewuradze Christ, hɛn Agyenkwa.

. Owiee kasaa n', nna sor adwontofo
Dze enyigye toow ndwom fofor koraa,
Wɔkamfoo Nyame dɔ a ɔropon hɛn,
Na Alleluia gyigyee wim' nyina;
Hɔn ndwom nye dɛ, Enyimnyam nka Nyame,
Asomdwee na enyisɔ mbra nyimpam'.

. Hɔ ara na nguanhwɛfo n', kɔr Bethlehem
Kɔhwɛɛ dza Nyame ayɛ ama adasa:
Wɔdze enyigye saan kɔhwɛɛ hɔn nguan,
Dɛ wɔda ho riyi Nyame ayɛw,
Yinom nye asomafo a wodzii kan
Wɔbɔɔ Abofra no ho nsɛm dawur.

. N-kyɛ yaakaa Nyame N' anwanwa dɔ a
Ogyaa N' ma ɔregye adasa nkwa;
Abofra a ɔama yeenya hɛn siar yi,
Yɛnhwɛ N' mbowadan mu nkɔ mbeamudua n' do:
Ɔmboa hɛn ma yentsia N' anamɔn mu
Nkodu adasa hɛn sor sibea hɔ.

. Adzekyee mba nyinara mu dansewa,
Pa hɛn isum na fa wo mboa brɛ hɛn;
Boka nworaba a epue ma wim' atsew wann,
Gya hɛn kɔ mbrɛ wɔawo Gyefo ama hɛn.

. Aso ampa dɛ hɛn so yɛbɛkyɛ No
Edom nduhuam na asomfo akyɛdze,
Mbepɔw do mbobaa, po do nankyenema,
Kwaa mu wandze, daadzetsirmu sika?

. Hwɛ, wɔawo Nyame Eguambaa a
Wɔdze N' bɔɔ anohoba n',
Oesian aba asaase
Rebɛkyerɛ hɛn ɔsor kwan.
Ao, hɛn siar da, aba yie!
Hwɛ hɛn nkwahosan aba!
Tow ndwom twa Jerusalem:
Wɔawo Christ wɔ Bethlehem!

. Hwɛ, nyia ɔtse ahengua do
Wɔ sorsor abɔfo ntam'
Nyia ɔyɛɛ wim' nworaba n',
Da mbowa dzidzidaka mu.

. Hom n-guanhwɛfo krɔnkrɔn,
Hom dze asɛmpa bɛn nam?
Wɔyɛ n' dɛn na hom egya
Hom nguan wɔ haban mu yi?

. Esuom a yɛroweɔn no,
Hwɛ, yehun kan nwanwa bi:
Abɔfo dze adwontow
Kaa dɛ wɔawo Agyenkwa n'.

. O Akɔkowaba krɔnkrɔn,
Wo dɔ yɛ nwanwa dodow!
Dɔ a ogyaa W' ma ifii sor
Baa wiadze a ɔtse dɛm yim'.

. Anago bi na nguanhwɛfo
Tsena fam' roweɔn hɔn nguan,
Ewuradze bɔfo fi sor bae,
Na kan hyerɛɛn hɔ nyina.

. Ihu kɛse kaa hɔn n-tsi
Ɔsee dɛ, Mma hom nnsuro:
Mebrɛ hom na adasa nyina
Asɛmpa a ɔyɛ dɛw.

. Wɔawo Agyenkwa ama hom
Wɔ David ahenkurowm',
Wɔawo Ewuradze Christ n-dɛ;
Yi na hom dze bohu N':

. Hom bohu dɛ Akɔkowaba n'
Da mbowa dzidzidakam',
Hom bohu No nantwibuw mu,
Dɛ tam kyekye No ho.

. Nyame bɔfo n' wiee dɛm ka ara,
Na sor dɔm pii bae a
Wɔdze ndwom yii Nyame ayɛw
Enyigye mu see dɛ:

. Ɔsor dɔ no ɔkrɔn dodow,
Nyame Baatan N' ayamuhyehye;
Ɔdze Agyenkwa fi sor bae,
Ɔmaa da pa n' hyerɛɛn hɛn do,
Na tsenenee ewia no puei,
Bɛtseew hɛn sum wiadze enyi.

. Nyame daa edzi wɔ Christ mu,
Dze Ne kan abɛpam hɛn sum,
Etu hɛn bɔn na enyifura,
Dze hɛn nan esi kwan pa mu;
Na hɛn akra a woenya fakyɛ,
Akɔ daa ahomgye man no '.

. Adom nwanwa, wɔawo N'
ampa!
Nyame Akyewa ɔabra nyimpa!
Ɔhen Jesus, Siar Enyidar,
Ɔasoa wiadze nkukunkakar.

. Nwanwa bɛn na metse n' wim'
yi?
Enyimnyam wo sor ma Nyame,
Asomdwee wɔ asaase do,
Enyisɔ wɔ adasa mu.

. Ao o! hom ntsie ahobowsɛm,
Nwanwa esi wo Bethlehem:
Ɔsor-asaase Twerammpon,
Wɔayɛ N' ɔbɔn ama abɔn.

. Abɔso Hen esian nyimpam',
N'adae nye mbowa
dzidzidakam',
Mbersantsen do a otra nhum,
Oeku Tamfo, ɔasɛɛ no tum.

. Yɔkaa Wo mbae, Nyame Ba
Christ;
'Wo na abɔpon Paradise.
Akra nyina bɔ se kamfo:
Enyimnyam nka Gyefo siarfo.

. Igyaa W' ahengua
Na W' ahenkyɛw so,
Ber a 'baa wiadze wɔ me ntsi n';
Na woennya kwan wɔ
Bethlehem fie hɔ,
Amma Wo wiadze ha ne mbae:
Ao, bra m' akomam', Ewuradze,
Ɔkwan wɔ m' akomam' ma Wo.

. Sor nyina gyigyee
Ber a abɔfo toow ndwom
Bɔɔ W' adehye dzin no dawur n';
Na mbrɛadzem' ara
Na, Ɔsor Wura,
Ebaa asaase do ha:
Ao, bra m' akomam', Ewuradze,
Ɔkwan wɔ m' akomam' ma Wo.

. N-sɔ wɔ etu,
Na nnoma berɛbuw,
Wɔ nkyindur no nwin ase;
Na Wo mpa nye dɛtse,
O Nyankopɔn Ba,
Dɛtse, wɔ Galilee sar do;
Ao, bra m' akomam', Ewuradze,
Ɔkwan wɔ m' akomam' ma Wo.

. Ao, Ewuradze,
'Dze nkasɛm no bae,
Dza nkyɛ ɔbɛma fahodzi;
Na wɔdze atwetwesi
Na nsoɛ katraka
Wosunsum Wo kɔr Calvary:
Ao, bra m' akomam', Ewuradze,
Ɔkwan wɔ m' akomam' ma Wo.

. Woana na n-guanhwɛfo
Kotow No mbowadan mu hɔ n'?
Ewuradze a! O anwanwasɛm!
Ewuradze a, Enyimnyam Hen n' a.
Yetwa hwe N' ananadze;
O wɔnhyɛ No abɔso Hen.

. Woana na oridzi edwin
Wɔ dan kakraba mu hɔ n'?

. Woana na ɔrekyen kɔm,
Ɔreper wɔ sar do hɔ n'?

. Woana na orusu wɔ
Lazarus ne nda do hɔ n'?

. Woana na ɔrobɔ mpaa
Esuom wɔ Gethsamane n'?

. Woana na ɔserɛ nhyira
Ma abɔn wɔ Calvary do n'?

. Woana na oefi ewufom'
Roboa hɛn, regye hɛn nkwa n'?

. Na nyimpa a wɔayɛ petsee yi,
Wɔnam ɔhyew do yi, ase ɛ?
Ebɛn nye adzekyee ehyia yi?
Wentwiwenti 'i ase nye dɛn?
Okuw n' sii ndze adze buaa dɛ,
Narazeth Jesus na ɔresen n'.

. Jesus nye woana? Ɔyɛ dɛn
Na ɔbɔ kurow ebutuw dɛm?
Ɔkwantsennyi a ɔresen,
Ɔdze bɛn twe nyimpa pii yi?
Awɔse ndze no buaa bio dɛ,
Narazeth Jesus na ɔresen n'.

. Jesus! 'No na ɔbaa wiadze
Boduaa mbusu kwan yi mu bi n';
Wɔdze ayarfo nyina brɛɛ No,
Etsitsifo ɔnye mpakye:
'Nyifurafo dze dɛw tsiee ntseamu n':
Narazeth Jesus na ɔresen n'.

. Ɔreba bio, fi ha kɔ ha,
Yɛtse N' anamɔn wɔ mbeambea,
Oegyina hɛn abobowano,
Ɔahɛn dɛ ɔrobɔsoɛ hɔ;
Ana hɛn so yɛnnkɛpaam' dɛ,
Narazeth Jesus na ɔresen n'.

. Metsee dɛ Jesus ne ndze se:
Bra Mo hɔ na bɔhom;
Ɔwo a aberɛ fa wo tsir,
Bɔto Mara Mo bom'!
Mokɔree dɛ mbrɛ metse ara,
Maberɛ, Mo werɛ ahow;
Minyaa ahomgye wɔ No mu,
Na ɔmaa m' enyigye.

. Metsee dɛ Jesus ne ndze se:
Ɔwo a sukɔm dze wo,
Hwɛ, mema n-kwa nsu no kwa,
Bɔ wo mu adze nom bi!
Mebaa Jesus hɔ mobɔnoom
N-kwa esutsen n' bi;
Mo nsukɔm gyaae, me kra nyaa nkwa,
Na afei metse No mu.

. Ɔwo a wɔpemee betsiee Wo,
Wotsiee Wo nsɛm, wɔtsee Wo tum;
Ma abɔn kwan ma yɛmbɛn Wo,
Na gye hɛn adom mu ara.

. Ɔwoara na aka dɛ,
Primprimfo nnhia oduyɛfo;
Emi meyar, mihia Wo mboa,
Mihia Wo tum a ɔgye nkwa n'.

. Wo tum, nokwar na nyamedɔ,
Tsim hɔ mbersantsen mfesantsen;
W' asɛm, W' adom asɛm kor mpo,
Otu yarba dzendzen biara.

. Kaansa makyɛr esu yi bo,
Ma mo sunsum nntum nnka noho a,
W' ano kasa bɛma masoɛr,
Ɔbɔbɔ m' esu ntsɛmara.

. Jesus frɛ hɛn! Sɛ hɛn bra po
Wor mpo a, yɛtse Ne ndze,
Ne ndze dɛɛdɛw n' gyigye daa daa,
Ɔse: Christian, ka Mo do.

. Tsetseber do asomafo n'
Tsee wɔ Galilee po do n',
Wogyaa ebusua, fie nye edwuma,
Kɛkaa' No a wɔdɔ No n' do.

. Jesus frɛ hɛn mma yɛnnsom
Wiadze mu ndzɛmba huhuw;
Ɔhwɛ ndzɛmba a wɔsom hɛn bo a,
Ɔse: Christian, dɔ M' kyɛn hɔn.

. Enyigye nye awerɛhow mu,
Dwumadzim' nye ahomgyem',
Ɔda ho frɛ hɛn dɛ yɛndɔ N'
Ma ɔkyɛn adze nyina.

. Ka 'sɛm dadaw no kyerɛ me,
Sunsum ndzɛmbam' asɛm,
Dza ɔfa Christ N' enyimnyam ho
Dza ɔfa No dɔ so ho.
Ka 'sɛm no pefee kyerɛ m' dɛ
Ereka kyerɛ abofra;
Na meyɛ mberɛw na mafona,
Minnyi ahom, mo ho fi.
Ka 'sɛm dadaw no kyerɛ me,
Jesus no dɔ ho asɛm.

. Tɔ w' bo ka 'sɛm no kyerɛ me,
Na meetum medze esie-
Nyame No werdam kɛse a
Ɔdze yɛ bɔn edur.
Si do mber pii ka kyerɛ m'
Na meyar awerɛfir;
Ahanamakye bɔsu
Ewia fir a ɔpa.

. Ka 'sɛm no bɔkɔɔ kyerɛ me,
Nwinwin mu dɛ ehiasɛm,
Kaa dɛ meyɛ bɔnyɛnyi a
Jesus bɛpeer mo nkwa,
Ka 'sɛm no mber nyinara,
Sɛ epɛ ampaara
Dɛ ema m' akomatɔm'
Wɔ ahokyer ber biaram'.

. Idzii mbuada adaduanan
Adzekyee nye adzesaa,
Adaduanan wɔ sar no do
Wɔsɔɔ Wo hwɛe na annyɛ bɔn.

. Ewia sii Wo do adzekyee,
Bɔw tɔɔ Wo do anago,
Mbowa abɔyafo paar wo ho,
Edaa fam', isum ɔbo.

. Ma yɛnsɔw Wo bene no bi,
Yɛmpow wiadze edzifodze;
Na yɛnye Wo nweɔn mpaabɔm',
Nye Wo nsɔw yaw ahoɔdzenm'.

. Sɛ abɔnsam dze ebufuw
Toa honam anaa sunsum,
'Wo a edzi no do nyim pɛn,
Dom hɛn mma yaannhwe ase.

. Jesus, motwer Wo, medze me kra twer Wo,
Fɔdzifo a mayew, 'Wo na 'botum agye m',
Obi nnyi sor anaa ase a ɔnye W' sɛ;
Ɔwo wui maa abɔn, Ɔwo wui maa me.
Motwer Wo dɔ no na mohwehwɛ W' enyim;
W' adom nwanwa no ntsi na muhuhor Wo.
Jesus, motwer Wo, medze me kra twer Wo,
Fɔdzifo a mayew, 'Wo na 'botum agye me.

. Jesus, m' bɔtwer Wo, m' bɔtwer Wo Kyerɛwsɛm;
Osiandɛ matse Wo mbɔbɔrhu ndze no.
Wo Sunsum kyerɛkyerɛ m' a, ɔyɛ m' dɛw dodow,
Ma mentsena W' anan ho ara mintsie.

. Jesus, m' bɔtwer Wo, mobɔdwen W' akwan do,
Ewɔ wiadze n' eyɛɛ dɔ nye mbɔbɔrhu,
Ndzebɔnyɛfo fɔɔr Wo, 'kwatafo hwehwɛɛ W',
Hɔn mu biara ho annyɛ Agyenkwa nkɔw.

. Mma nnsu mma Nyia ɔso mbeamudua
Dze rokɔ Calvary no;
Ɔnnserɛ dasanyi ne nyinsu,
Ɔapen dɛ obowu.

. Yaw huhu bi a atow N' enyim,
Oegura ne nyimpadua n',
Mmfir amenhyɛ anaa 'nyimguase:
Onnsuro mbeamudua n'.

. Yaw wenwen a ɔbor do yi,
Ahoguan a ɔnnka,
Dza Wo dɔ nnya mu ahotɔ yi,
Wo nko so ne nyina.

. Ohu akra a hɔn ntsi oruwu
Dɛ wɔtar hɔn bɔn ho,
Hɔn a ɔsor-man dzi wɔ hɔn
Wɔmmpɛ dɛ wɔhɛn mu.

. Yaw Nyimpa! Wɔnhwɛ dzin bi a
Wɔdze frɛɛ Nyame Ne Ba a
Ɔbɛgyee adasa nkwa
Alleluia! Ɔgyefo bɛn a!

. Wɔhyɛɛ N' fɛr, woyii N' ehi,
Wɔdze m' afɔdzi soaa No;
No bɔgyaa sii m' fakyɛ pi:
Alleluia! Ɔgyefo bɛn a!

. Yedzi fɔ, hɛn ho yɛ nkɔw
Na Ɔno nye mpata-guan:
Bo adwe koraa!- aso ampa?
Alleluia! Ɔgyefo bɛn a!

. Ɔsɛn wimu na owui,
Ɔkaam' dɛ, Afei mewie!
N-dɛ wɔakrɔn No wɔ sor
Alleluia! Ɔgyefo bɛn a!

. Aa! Jesus krɔnkrɔn, ebɛn na ayɛ,
Na nyimpa dze enyitan bu Wo fɔ yi?
Atamfo si W' atwetwe, wodze apa W',
Ao, mandzehunyi.

. Woana dzi so? Woana dze yi baa Wo do?
Ao, Jesus, mo bɔn na ɔabɔ W' mbusu yi;
Mara a, Wura Jesus, emi na mepaa W':
'Mi mobɔɔ W' mbeamuduam':

. 'Mi ntsi, Jesus pa, na ebɛyɛɛ nyimpa,
Wo wuyaw wenwen, na wo nkwa afɔrbɔ;
Wo wum' ahoguan, W' amandzehu yawyaw,
'Mi mo nkwagye ntsi a.

. Kokwaa bi wɔ ekyirkyir noho,
Kurow bi ban ekyir,
Hɔ na wɔsɛɛn Ewuradze a
Owui dze gyee hɛn nkwa n'.

. Yennkotum yeehu, yɛakyerɛ yaw
A ɔsɔwee no dur;
Na yɛgye dzi dɛ hɛn ntsi na
Ɔsɛɛn hɔ na owui.

. Owui ma yeenya bɔnfakyɛ,
Owui ma yaayɛ yie,
N' adehye bɔgya n' aagye hɛn,
Ewiei n' yaakɔ sor manm'.

. Obi nnyihɔ a oye dɛ Ɔno
Na oeetua bɔn ho kaw n';
No nko na otum bue sor abow n'
Na ɔdze hɛn kɔ mu.

. Nyame Eguambaa, yɛrekaa,
Wo dɔ a woepira no n',
Fi sor noho gye hɛn do,
Na bohu hɛn mbɔbɔr:
Kaa hɛn a yɛdwen Wo ho;
Na gye kra biara a ɔreper;
O, yɛserɛ W', kaa Calvary,
Na ma yɛnkɔ asomdweem'!

. W' amandzehu yayaw no,
Wo bɔgyaa fifir no,
Wo dɔ a ɔmaa iwui ntsi,
Yɛserɛ W' , yi hɛn bɔn kɔ;
Bubu hɛn mpokyerɛ mu na
Gye hɛn emumuyɛ nyinam';
O, yeserɛ W', kaa Calvary,
Na ma yɛnkɔ asomdweem'!

. Moto m' enyi hwɛ anwanwa dua a
Enyimnyam Hen no tɔɔr do n' a,
M' adze pa biara mummbu n' hwee,
M' ahopɔw nyina yɛ m' nkɔnkɔw.

. Mo Wura, ɔmpar me dɛ m' botuw,
Gyedɛ m' Agyenkwa No wu mu:
Egyangyandze a modɔ kɛse n',
Mobɔ n' afɔr ma No bɔgyaa.

. Hwɛ mbrɛ yaw na ɔdɔ rosɔn
Ne tsir, Ne nsa, nye N' anan ho:
Dɛm dɔ na yaw yi mmbɔɔ mu pɛn,
Na nsoɛ kyɛw yi bi nnsoaa bi da.

. Onyame dɔ! 'bɛn na ayɛ 'i?
Bɛkyebo Nyame ewu ama m'!
Egya No domankoma Ba N'
Soaa mo bɔn nyina wɔ dua n' do;
Bɛkyebo Nyame ewu ama m'!
Mo Wura, mo Dɔ, wɔabɔ N' mbeamuduam'.

. Akwantsemfo nyina hom nhwɛ
N-kwa na Asomdwee Hen ruwu!
Abɔn hom Bɔfo na oruwu 'il!
Aso yaw bi nye Nedze 'i sɛ?
Hom nye m' mbɔsɔ No bɔgyaa nhwɛ:

Mbrɛ wo mfem' bɔgya n' wɔ;
M'enyidar, m'asɛm nyina nye yi,
Agyenkwa wui maa me.

. M'Agyenkwa a 'ruwu, me Nyame,
Bura a ehor bɔn fi,
Fa Wo bɔgyaa n' petse mo do
Ma mo ho ɔntsew krɔnn.

. Guar me, na ma menyɛ Wodze,
Guar me, na yɛ medze
Nnyɛ me nan nko, na me nsa ho,
Me tsirm', na m'akomam'.

. Israel Guanhwɛfo, na medze
Me kra ne dɛw, n'ahwehwɛdze,
Mo 'koma haahaw hwehwɛ Wo,
Mo Kɔn dɔ dɛ menye Wo tsena;
Meper mehu mfunoma pa no,k
Mbrɛ hɔn a wotsie Guanhwɛfo n'
Wɔtwer Wo bom' na wodzidzi n',
Na ewia ne hyew nn-ka hɔn.

. Ao! kyerɛ me siar bea yi no do,
Mbrɛ Wo nkorɔfo nyina tse,
Mbrɛ ahotsewfo dze dɛw hwɛ
Nyame a wɔabɔ N' mbeamudua mu n';
Da Wo dɔ nwanwa no edzi,
W'ahoguan, Wo wu wɔ dua n' do;
Fa me kra kɔ Calvary do,
Menye W' nhu amandze, ndzi konyim.

. Ewuradze, yi Woho kyerɛ hɛn,
Ber a yekyin wiadze;
Kasa kyerɛ hɛn akoma,
Ma Wo dɔ ndzɛw hɛn mu.

. 'Nye hɛn kasa a, hɛn werɛ fir
Aber, ɔberɛ dadwen;
Dwuma yɛ ahomgye, yaw yɛ dɛw,
Ber a, Nyame, ebɛn hɛn.

. Bra me nkyɛn mbɔ, m'adom Nyame,
Ma m'akoma ndzi dɛw;
Makoma bɔbɔ no mu adze
Ama W', oetsie Wo ndze.

. Ao, nkyɛ maatakyer Nyame ho,
Meenya su a ɔdwe,
Kandzea ma ɔaakyerɛ kwan no a
Ɔdze m' kɔ Eguambaa n' nkyɛn.

. Nhyira a ber a muhun Ewuradze n'
Minyae no wɔ henfa?
Jesus ho yikyerɛ na N'asɛm
A muhunii n' wɔ hen?

. Asomdwee mber a mehu pɛn a!
Mbrɛ ho nkaa dua yɛ dɛ a!
Na ndɛ me kra atɔ pan a
Wiadze nntum nnhyɛ no ma.

. Ao, Ebubur Krɔnkrɔn, san bra,
Ahomgye ho Bɔfoe,
Mikyir bɔn a opiraa Wo n',
Na ɔpaam Wo m'akomam'.

. Dza modɔ no mbordo biara,
Mbrɛ no su tse biara,
Boa ma minyi n' W'ahengua ho,
Na monsom Wo nkotoo.

. Ɔkɔm na nsukɔm dze m';
Jesus yɛ m'edziban:
Nkwa esutsen, pem fi
Ɔbotan no mu ma m'.

. Ɔwo a eyɛ Paanoo,
Ma m' daadaa edziban;
Dɛ mbrɛ enyɛn akra n',
Nyɛn m', ɔno mubowu.

. Nokwar Wenyinaba,
Ma monsɔ Wo dɛw nhwɛ;
Woara ma m' nkwa fofor,
Na fa dɔ nyɛn me kra.

. Ber a m'akwantu hyɛɛ ase
Mbɔntankyim' na mekyin:
Sor Edziban, nyɛn me;
Nyimpa Ba, yɛ me boa.

. Wo nkyɛn ara, Nyame,
Wo nkyɛn ara!
Kaansa mbeamudua mpo
Na ɔma mo do a,
Mo ndwom dabaa nye dɛ
Wo nkyɛn ara, Nyame,
Wo nkyɛn ara.

. Kaansa mirikyin mpo
Ma wi akɔtɔ,
Ma adze so asa me,
Ma mesum bo a,
M'adaaso mu m'bepin
Wo nkyɛn ara, Nyame,
Wo nkyɛn ara.

. Ma kwan m-bɛda hɔ a
Wɔdze kɔ sor;
Dza edze ma m' nyina
Ehumbɔbɔr kwa;
Abɔfo refrɛfrɛ m'
Wo nkyɛn ara, Nyame,
Wo nkyɛn ara.

. Ber a m'enyi betsetsew n',
M'beyi W' ayɛw;
M'bodua m'awerɛhow mu
M'esi Nyame fi;
Menam me yawm' m'bepin
Wo nkyɛn ara, Nyame,
Wo nkyɛn ara!

. Memmper bio dɛ m'bɛsakyer hweeara
Ansaana Dɔfo kɛse yi aba:
Misiesie n' yie dɛn ara a, ɔmmfata;
Misianka W' kakra so a, ɔnnsɛ koraa.

. Mbrɛ etse n' ara, fa W'ahotsew nye dɛw
Bra dan mu bɔhwɛ mbrɛ no mu tse ara;
W'enyimnyam kɛse na m'ahohia ntsi
Munnsuro dɛ m'bɛgye W' asoɛ me fi.

. Mihia Wo Mber Nyina,
Domfo Ewuradze;
Ndze bi nntse dɛ Wodze a,
Ɔma asomdwee.
Mihia Wo, ao, mihia Wo,
Mber nyina mihia Wo;
M'Agyenkwa, Maba Wo hɔ,
Hyira me sesei.

. Mihia Wo mber nyina,
Pinkyɛn me daa;
Ber a Ɔwo bɛn me n'
Mennyɛ bɔn da.

. Mihia Wo mber nyina,
Dɛw mu o, yaw mu o;
Bra ntsɛm bɛnye me ntsena,
Mma ɔbra annyɛ gyan.

. Jesus, me Gyefo, Nua, Nyɛnko,
M'adwendwen nyina da Wo do;
Adze nyina mu medan Wo:
Woara hyehɛ na gye m'asɔr.

. Sɛ W'adom a ɔma nkwagye n'
Na menya masɔ bi mahwɛ,
Sɛ Woara Wo Sunsum nye m' tse
Na ɔdze N'atsaban kata m' do a:

. Nna ma ɔnda ho ɔnhyɛ me dzen,
Na mma onngyaa m' hɔ ara da,
Ma ɔmpa m' esian nye mbusu,
Onsie me kra ma ɔnyɛ fofor,

. Sɛ mofom fi kwan pa nom' a,
Ma mentse Ne ndze wɔ m'ekyir
Dɛ, San, bodua wo kwan Christ mu,
Guan kɔ Christ hɔ, na bɔn abɛn.

. No ngo krɔnkrɔn a ofi sor
Nda ho nkyekye mo werɛ, nkyerɛ m' kwan,
Nkɛpem dɛ m'akoma bɔgow
Na Noara dze dɔ bɛtsena mu.

. Christ nsordafo, hom nsoɛr,
Hom mmia hom akodze,
Nyɛ dzen wɔ tum a Nyame nam
No domankoma Ba n' do ma n'
Nyɛ dzen Dɔm Ewuradzem'
Na No tum ahoɔdzenm'
Nyia ɔtwer Jesus N'ahoɔdzen n' yɛ
Konyimdzifo mbordo.

. Hom ngyina No tum kɛsem'
Mfa N'ahoɔdzen nyina nhyɛ
Na wɔmfa Nyame akodze n'
Mmia wɔ ɔko no mu;
Wɔayɛ adze nyina ewie n',
Na nkodzen abɔ adze n'
Hom nam Christ do eedzi konyim,
Ewiei n' hom eedzi mu.

. Hom nsoɛr ntsia atamfo
Wɔ mpu-na-mpu ko mu
Wɔnko ntsia mbɔnsam dɔmtutuw
Wɔ mbusu da nyinam'
Wɔnye sum mu mba nsi
Wɔnserew hɔn apam hun
Wɔmma ɔsor kan akodze
Ɔnye tsenenee nhyɛ hɔn.

. Memmfɛr dɛ m'bɛgye mo Wura atom'
Na maper N'edwuma ho,
Mesuo N'asɛm ho enyidzim',
Ne mbeamudua ho enyimnyam n'.
(Mbeamudua ho, mbeamudua ho, mbrɛ
midzii kan muhun kan,
Na m'akoma n'adzesoa n' pirewii fii hɔ;
Hɔ na menam gyedzim' muhum adze,
Na afei m'ahom ka mo ho daa.)

. Jesus, me Nyame! minyim No,
Ne dzin nye m'adze nyina;
Ɔnnkɛma me kra afɛr da
Na m'enyidar ayew.

. N'asɛm tsim hɔ dɛ N'ahengua
Na obotum akora
Dza medze ahyɛ Ne nsa n' yie
Ekodu ekyir da n'.

. Soɛr, Ewuradze N'abasa, soɛr!
Fa Wo bɛkyebo tum no hyɛ;
Esoɛr a, hɛll 'henman wosow,
W'atamfo gu ebiritsi.

. Ewuradze, W'abaw du mbea nyina,
No tum a ɔgye nkwa mmbɔ adze;
Eda ho nye Wo nkorɔfo tse
Egye hɔn fi ɔbra asorɛkyem'.

. Christian! mma mmpɛ ahomgye ndɛ
Tow w' ahomgye adaaso n' gu;
Ewɔ atamfo finimfin:
Weɔn na sɔr.

. Etumfo nye akɛsefo
Rotwe hɔn dɔm wɔ akono,
Wɔbɔkɔ wo ntoa awerɛfirm';
Weɔn na sɔr.

. Tsie hɔn a woedzi konyim n'
Wɔrohwɛ mbrɛ isi ko;
Hɔn nyina yɛ ano kor se:
Weɔn na sɔr.

. Nkanka tsie w' Ewuradze,
Ɔno a edɔ dɛ itsie n';
Fa N'asɛm sie w'akomam':
Weɔn na sɔr.

. Ao o, m'afɛ! hom nhwɛ frankaa
Rinyam wɔ sor hɔ!
Afei nkyidɔm riyi hɔnho,
Konyim abɛm hɛn.
Wontsim aban n', na mereba,
Jesus rinyam nsa;
Wɔnto ano nse n' sor hɔ dɛ,
W'adaworom yetsim n'.

. Hwɛ dɔmtutuw a wɔreba,
Abɔnsam dzi kan:
Akatakyi rohwe ase,
Mbanyinndam pέ etu!

. Hwɛ, konyim frankaa no rinyam!
Tsie, abɛn rehɛn,
Yɛdze hɛn Hen dzin bedzi nyim
Wɔ adɔm nyina do.

. Wɔnko! wɔnko nyi dɔm, Jesus
nsordaafo,
Wɔntwer N'ehumbɔbɔr,
wɔntwer Nanosɛm;
Wɔmma Nsempa frankaa n' do
wɔ wim' nkyerɛ;
Wɔntrɛ mu daa ma aman n-
hwɛ ne fɛw.
Wɔnko nyi dɔm! ako-mbarimba,
Wɔnko! gyedɛ hom dzi konyim,
Wɔnko nyi dɔm! mma
wonngyaam' da;
Na ahomgye n' ayɛ homdze.

. Sɛ ngyata na yɛbɛnye hɔn
ehyia mpo a,
Yerinngyina gyede Zion
abowano;
Daa nyina yɛhom do yɛkɔ hen
enyim,
Kodu Jordan do mbrɛ hɛn enyi
tua fie n'.
Wɔnko nyi dɔm! ako-mbarimba,
Wɔnko! gyedɛ hom dzi konyim,
Wɔnko nyi dɔm! mma
wonngyaam' da;
Na ahomgye n' ayɛ homdze.

. Wɔnko! wɔnko nyi dɔm,
mbeamudua ho dɔm,
Wɔmpow enyigye na fona nyɛ
hom fɛw;
Wommiamia hom ntoa mu,
mmintsim hom mfowa yie;
Wondzi nyim ara nkɔ, wonko
mma hɛn Wura.
Wɔnko nyi dɔm! ako-mbarimba,
Wɔnko! gyedɛ hom dzi konyim,
Wɔnko nyi dɔm! mma
wonngyaam' da;
Na ahomgye n' ayɛ homdze.

. Mma nngyaa mu mma ngyigye
Na ngyaamu yɛ bɔn,
Konyim kor bɔboa w' ma
Eedzi nyim bi so;
Ko mbarimbam' kɔ w'enyim
Hom w'apɛdze do,
Hwɛ Jesus ara daa,
Ɔdze w' bokodu.
Bisa Agyenkwa no hɔ mboa,
Ahoɔdzen nye akomatɔmu;
Ɔpe dɛ obɔboa wo,
Ɔdze w' bokodu.

. HƐN Nyame yɛ abankɛse
Akokyɛm nye akodze,
Amandze aba hɛn do dze,
Naaso ɔgye No nkorɔfo,
Tamfo n' rohwehwɛ hɛn,
Ɔpɛ hɛn mbusu pa;
Na no tum so ɔso,
Ndaadaa pii na ɔdze ko
Obi nnsɛ no wiadze ha.

. Nyimpa ahoɔdzen dze osuar,
Ɔnnkyɛr na yɛahwe ase;
Hɛn Gyefo nye Ɔbarimba a
Nyame eyi N' esi hɔ,
Epɛ ehu Ne dzin?
Wɔfrɛ No Jesus Christ,
Edɔm Ewuradze
No domankoma Ba;
Ne nsamu na konyimdzi wɔ.

. Sɛ mbɔnsam ahyɛ wiadze ma
Rohwehwɛ amen hɛn a,
Mma hom mma hɛn bo nntu koraa
Wonnkutum afa hɛn do,
Ma abɔnsam no bo mfuw,
Ɔnyɛ n'enyim kusuww;
Onnkotum ayɛ hwee,
Woebu no fɔ dada;
Asɛm kor bɔhwe n' ase.

. Tsetse Bo a wɔpaae maa me,
Ma munguan nhunta Wo mu;
Ma nsu no nye bɛgya n' a
Ofi Wo mfem' repem no,
Ɔnyɛ bɔn edufanu,
Ɔmpa m' fɔ, ɔnsan mo ho.

. Sɛ me nyinsu kyi daa mpo,
Sɛ mo mbɔdzen nngow da mpo,
Yinom nnkotum bɔn wer tɔ;
Gyefo nye Wo nkotonoo:
Me nsam' nnyi akatua bi,
Metetar Wo mbeamudua n'.

. Asomdwee pa, wɔ bɔn wiadze yi mu?
Jesus bɔgya ɔwasa asomdwee.

. Asomdwee pa, dwumadzi akyer do yi?
Ebɛyɛ Jesus Ne pɛ nye ahomgye.

. Asomdwee pa, yaw etwa ehyia hɛn yi?
Jesus No bom' asomdwee ara nko.

. Asomdwee pa, adɔfo apetse yi?
Jesus kora hɛn do yi, hwee nnkɛyɛ hɛn.

. Asomdwee pa, yennyim hɛn ndaamba yi?
Yenyim Jesus, na ɔtse ahengua n' do.

. Asomdwee pa, wu gyegye hɛn do yi?
Jesus apansam wu na no tum nyina.

. Onyame dua kwan sunsum mu
Na ɔyɛ N'anwanwadze;
Ɔdze N'anamɔn taataa pom',
Ɔko ehum do nantsew.

. Asaase no bun mu noho,
Ɔdze nyansa nwanwa
Kora Ne nhyehyɛɛ pa a ɔsom bo n',
Ɔyɛ dza Noara pɛ.

. Esiarfo a hom suro, hom nnhyɛ ahom,
Ifua a hom suro n' kɛse n',
Mbɔbɔrhu ma, na ɔbɛpaa
Nhyira egu hom do.

. Mma hom mmfa hom nyimpa-dwen mmbua
Nyame, hom ntwer N'adom,
Ber a ɔaka N'enyim esi n'
Na N'ano serew hyɛm'

. No botae bɛber ntsɛmara,
Ɔbɛhan mber nyina;
Kukuduuduw n' yɛ wen mpo a,
Nhyiren n' botu huam pa.

. Wo kwan a; nnyɛ medze,
Sɛ no mu kadoo mpo a,
Wankasa gye m' taataa;
Kyerɛ m' kwan a mundua mu.
No mu ye o, no mu muo o,
Ɔnoara na oye;
Ɔkyeakyea o, ɔtsen o,
Wɔdze kɔ W'ahomgyem'.

. Mennkɛfa dza mepɛ;
Wɔse m' mpo a mennkɛfa:
Mo Wura, Woara, fa ma m'
Na ɔayɛ kwan pa ama m'.
Ɔman a mohwehwɛ n'
Wodze a; na ma kwan a
Wɔdze kɔm' so nyɛ Wodze,
Ɔno m'bɔtɔ dɔnsuar.

. Medze mo bɔn brɛ Wo
Dza munntum ano bu,
Ama aahor ne nyina
Wɔ bɔgya bura no mu.
M'Agyenkwa, medze ne nyina brɛ W';
No dur hyɛ me kra do dodow.

. Medze m'akoma brɛ Wo,
'Koma a minnyim mu nsɛm;
Kɔhwinyi, kobɔnyi n',
Akoma bɔn ampa.
M'Agyenkwa, medze hyɛ Wo nsa
Ma m'akoma nsi pi mma Wo.

. Medze m' dadwen brɛ Wo,
Dadwen a munntum munnguan n'
Ama eesuo mo mu
Ama eeyi no hɔ.
M'Agyenkwa dɔfo, Wo nkyɛn na
Medze m'adzesoa yi meba.

. Medze me yaw brɛ Wo,
Yaw a munntum nnka n' a;
Ɔnngye dɛ meka mpo,
Ɔnngye dɛ meka mpo,
Woara nyim ne nyina.
M'Agyenkwa a Woara so nyim yaw,
Medze m'awerɛhow brɛ Wo.

. Medze me dɛw brɛ Wo,
Dɛw a Wo dɔ dze ana m',
Dɛ memfa nyɛ atwer a
Mofow mipinkyɛn Wo.
Gyefo, Woara tɔɔ ne nyina maa m';
Medze ne nyina gu W'enyim.

. M'Agyenkwa Ne nkyɛn hɔ-
Sor nye me fie-
Ɔbɛhyɛ m' enyimnyam,
Sor nye me fie;
Eyiefo nye esiarfὸ a
Modɔ hɔn nyina wɔ hɔ;
Hɔ na mo so m'bɔhom,
Sor nye me fie.

. MEDA Jesus abawm' sɔnn,
Meda No bo mu komm,
No dɔ no kata mo do,
Me kra bɔhom hɔ komm.
Tsie! Abɔfo hɔn ndze a;
Wɔdze rotow ndwom frɛ m',
Fir enyimnyam sar no do,
Fir jasper po n' egya.
Meda Jesus abawn' sɔnn,
Motwer No bo mu komm,
No dɔ no kata mo do,
Me kra bɔhom hɔ komm.

. Meda Jesus abawn' sɔnn,
Mefi kɔdaannda nsa,
Mefi wiadze ngyigye nsa,
Bɔn nnkotum ahaw m' hɔ.
Aka nsɔhwɛ kumaabi,
Aka nyinsu kumaabi,
Ma meefi awerɛhow nsa,
Ma meefi suro nsa.

. Metse dɛ Gyefo n' se,
"W' ahoɔdzen suar ampa;
Na dwen do weɔn na sɔr,
Fa Me yɛ w'adze nyina."
Jesus tuaa ne nyina,
Ne nyina fir Noara;
Bɔn egu mo ho fi dɛnn,
Ɔahor ma ayɛ fitaa.

. Ewùradze, menyà ehu
Dɛ Wo nkotsee Wo tum
Na otu kwata bɔr,
Na ɔnam 'koma bo.

. 'Midze, minnyi yie bi a
Medze bɛgye W'adom;
M'bɔhor me ntar fitaa
Wɔ Eguambaa bɔgyaa mu.

. Da bi a me kra bɔsoɛr
Mo wumpa dὸ afow sor,
"Jesus tuaa ne nyina!"
Begyigye wim' hɔ nyina.

. Mber pii na maka n' mo mu;
Dɛ, Woana bɔfow sor,
Akɛfa Ewuradze Christ,
Dze No esian famu?
Adwendwen dze me botu,
Ma mekohu Noara
Mbrɛ abɔfo yi No ayɛw,
Wonya adzekyee nwoaraba n'.

. Mber pii na maka n' mo mu:
Woana besian bun n' mu,
Akɛfa Ewuradze Christ,
Efi ewufom' aba?
Medze nokwar mbrɛahoadze
Siesie m'akoma mu dze a,
Christ bɛhɛn mo mu hɔ ntsɛm,
Nye me abɛtsena daa.

. Gyedzinyi, twer No, twer No,
Sɛ ko n' kyer do dɛn arà a;
Ɔyɛ dέn arà a ibedzi nyim,
Wo Nyame b]ko ama w'.
Twer No, twer No,
Sɛ sum n' yɛ hu dɛn ara a;
Twer No, twer No,
Na adzekyee no abɛn.

. Twer No, na mbusu n' rebɛn,
Ngyigye dzendzen rebɛn;
Obokutow wo arta
Ɔbra n'awor huhu n'.

. Hɛn Wura, kyerɛ hɛn ma yɛnsɔr yie,
Yɛmfia enyindzi na suro:
Kaansa yɛyɛ dɛtse na nso a,
Otwar dɛ yɛbɛn Wo.

. Yegyaa sɔr a na yeedzi emia:
Dom hɛn tua ma yɛnsɔr!
Na yɛroboa hɛnho nye W' ehyia a,
Ewuradze, hyia hɛn kwan.

. Ma hɛn ahobrɛadze ɔnye
Bɔn ho nnuho krɔnkrɔn,
Awerɛhyɛmu dzendzen a ɔma
Yɛtse Wo ndze nya nkwa.

. Dom hɛn gyedzi wɔ Afɔr a
No nko tum pata bɔn n';
Ma yɛmfa enyidar enyi
Ntsim Christ n-ko ara do.

. Abotar a 'kyɛr dɛn ara a
Ɔweɔn, ɔtweɔn na osu;
Mbanyinndam a osie hɛn kra
Na 'ruku n' mpo a ɔtwer Wo.

. YƐBA W'ahengua enyim
Bobu ntwɛr totɔ sѐrɛ Wo a,
Wo dɔ ntsi yέ aso ma hɛn;
Jesus krɔnkrɔn, tsie hɛn.

. 'Wo a egye ndzebɔnyɛfo,
Na hor hɔn ho fi nyina,
Fa Wo bɔgyaa san hɛn ho:
Jesus krɔnkrɔn, tsie hɛn.

. Ma yɛnhyɛ hɛn honam do,
Ma yendzi wiadze do nyim,
Kã abɔnsam gu ma hɛn:
Jesus krɔnkrɔn, tsie hɛn.

. Sɛ awѐrɛhow hyɛ hɛn do,
Sɛ yarba tsew tɔ hɛn do,
Sɛ owu dze hɛn rokɔ a:
Jesus krɔnkrɔn, tsie hɛn.

. Asomdwee Hen!
Ɔbɔn no dɔm abɛn!
Naaso yɛwɔ Wo nsam' a hwee nnyɛ hɛn.

. Asomdwee Hen!
Yehia Wo daa nyina,
Dɛ nkwa na owu mu nye hɛn ntsena.

. Me kra nam mo Pomfo no do,
Efi owu mprɛnu no nsa;
Woeyi m'enyi wɔ nyinsuwa mu,
Woeyi m'anan so efi hɛll.

. Bɛkyebo Kan! Bɛkyebo Kan!
Mbrɛ kra ho wɔ dɛ ɔtsew
Wɔ W'enyim a, Ehuntahunii;
Ɔmmpem adze, mbom ɔdze dɛw
Tum gyina na ɔhwɛ Wo.

. W'ahengua ho esunsum dze
Tum sɔw siar hyɛnn no;
Na hɔn nko na hɔn su tse dɛm,
Osiandɛ wonnhum bɔn wiadze a
Ɔtse dɛ iyi pɛn.

. Ao, m'bɛyɛ dɛn na 'mi a wɔawo m'
Sum mu, m'adwen kusuww,
Metum mepue, Nyame, Wenyim,
Na mo sunsum kwatserkwaa yi
Asɔw nserɛmɛn hyɛnn no?

. Kwan bi wɔ hɔ ma nyimpa dɛ
Ɔdze fow kɔ sor fie;
Afɔr bi a wɔabɔ ama hɛn,
Nyame enyim Twitwagyefo,
Sunsum krɔnkrɔn No tum.

. Agyenkwa Jesus, fi sor bra!
Fa W'adom krɔnkrɔn n' bɔboa me:
Pra wiadze dɔ fi m'akomam'
Na siesie mu fa ma Woho.

. O, ma Wo krɔnkrɔnyɛ nhyɛ n' ma
Na mo sunsum no kɔn ndɔ Wo!
Ewia o, anago, o, me pɛ kor
Nye dɛ minya Wo midzi mee.

. Kwan a m'Agyenkwa, W'anamɔn
Hyerɛn mu n', nna m'boduam' mbrɛhoadzem';
Minnketsie na mennkɛka dɔ
Fofor bi ho asɛm dɛ Wodze n'.

. Me kra a metu mahyɛ Wo nsa 'i,
Mma enyigye huhuw nnyam' kyɛpɛn:
Woara fa, na Ewɔ ho kwan
Dɛ akoma n' nyina No Wura.

. Ɔwo nko ara na mutum,
Medze enyigye krɔnn dɔ Wo;
Egyigye kɛse bɛn nye yi
Dɛ muhu dɛ edze m' yɛ Wodze!

. Dza ɔyɛ dzen sen adze nyina
Nye dɛ m'begyaa bɔn yɛ koraa;
Naaso ne yɛ nnyɛ dzen, minyim:
Jesus, hwɛ Wo nokwaredzi no!
Sɛ biribiara nnyɛ dzen mma Wo a,
Adze nyina ne yɛ nnyɛ dzen mma m'

. Ao, nkyɛ meenya 'koma a bɔn nnyim
Dze eyi Nyame ayɛw!
Dza ɔtse Wo bɔgyaa no tum,
Bɔgya a wɔkae gui maa m'.

. Akoma a ɔdwe, bɔbɔfo,
Mo Pomfo N'ahengua,
Mbrɛ Christ n-ko na ɔkasa,
Mbrɛ Jesus nko dzi hen.

. Akoma brɛfo a ɔtwer Wo,
Nokwafo a no mu tsew;
'Koma a nkwa anaa wu nntum mmpaa
Mmfi nyia ɔtsem' no ho.

. Akoma a ɔasakyer koraa,
Na Nyame dɔ ahyɛm' ma;
Odzi mu, na no mu tsew koraa,
Nyame, ɔnye Wo sɛ!

. Mo Wùra Jesus, mo kɔn dɔ dɛ midzi mu!
Morohwehwɛ dɛ etsena mo mu daa.
Dwuruw abosom, yi atamfo edzi,
Guar m' sesei ma monhoa dέ esukwankyɛba.
Monhoa fitaa, nyew, monhoa fitaa,
Guar m' sesei ma monhoa dɛ esukwankyɛba.

. Jesus, mma efifidze biara nn-ka,
Fa Wo bɔgyaa botu nkekaaba nyina;
Dɛm ahohor ntsi mopow adze nyina,
Guar m' sesei ma monhoa dɛ esukwankyɛba.

. Jesus, fi sor ahengua do tὸ enyi hwɛ m',
Boa me ma mombɔ afɔr a odzi mu;
Medze moho nye dza mowɔ nyina ma Wo,
Guar m' sesei ma monhoa dέ esunkwankyɛba.

. Jesus, yi ntsi na mokotow mesѐrɛ Wo,
Ewùradze, mokosɔw W'ananadze ha;
Me gyedzi enyi tua dɛ Wo bɔgyaa repem,
Guar m' sesei ma monhoa dέ esukwankyɛba.

. Mo Wùra Jesus, W'ahoɔfɛw n'
Na mo kɔn dɔ dɛ m'bohu;
Wo suban, W'adwen fɛɛfɛw n'
Mepɛ mahwɛ mpu-na-mpu.
Hue W'adom gu me kra do,
Mo mu bɔn nyina popo.

. Obiara nnkenyà ahotɔ,
Gyedɛ Woara tsena no mu.
Tsew m'adwen ho, ma me dɔ,
Ma m' Nyame dɔ a odzi mu.
Ao, Gyefo dɔfo, yɛ ntsɛm,
Yɛ ntsɛm fa Woho bɛkyɛ m'.

. Egya, megye dzi pi
Dɛ eyɛ mbɔbɔrhufo:
'Bɛsan me kra fɔdzifo n' ho,
Na ayɛ me fofor.

. Dɛm a, Jesus ntsi, bra,
Ma m'akoma mu ntsew:
Botwa mo fona nyina do,
Na ma mingyaa bɔn yɛ.

. Adom do na menam
Mesan meba Wo hɔ:
Ewuradze, to m'akoma pan
Na krɔnkrɔnyɛ nhyɛ n' ma.

. Mosɔr mberɛw mu serɛ tum,
Hyɛ W'ahendzi no ma
Ndɛ a wɔfrɛ no n-dɛ yi,
Na mennkɛyɛ bɔn bio.

. Munntum nnhor m'akoma,
Gyedɛ megye Wo dzi,
Na motweɔn Wo bɔgyaa a ɔma
Wansayɛ krɔnkrɔn no.

. Minyim dɛ mo Pomfo tse ase,
Na ɔsɔr ma me daa nyina;
Ɔma No dɔ ho sɛnkyerɛdze,
Eyiedzi ahobadze a.

. Muhu N' dɛ ɔrema me tsir do,
Ɔdze nkwagye abɛn ha,
W'enyim yɛ me dehye ampaara,
Na ɔnnkɛkyɛr na ɔaba.

. Ɔpɛ dɛ meyɛ hotsewnyi;
'Bɛnadze siw Ne pɛ kwan?
N'adom pamfo a ɔwɔ mo mu n'
Ɔbɛhyɛ m' ma ampaara

. Jesus W'asɛm na midzi do;
Me gyedzi nyina nye dɛ
Mo Wura, ebɛsan na agye m',
Ama Woara Woho.

. Wodze daa! Ɔdɔ Nyame,
Fi sor W'ahenguam tsie hɛn;
Yɛnyɛ Wodze afebɔɔ,
Wɔ ha na mbersantsen nyinam'.

. Wodze daa! n-kwa Wura,
Kora hɛn wɔ bra aperdzim';
Wo nye Nkwa n', Nokwar n' na Kwan n',
Gya hɛn kɔ kan man no mu.

. Wodze daa! Ao, esiarfo
Bɛn nye hɔn a wɔhom Wo mu!
Gyefo, Weɔmfo, Sor Nyɛnko,
Ao, twitwa gye hɛn kɔ ewiei!

. Wodze daa! Oguanhwɛfo,
Wo nguan a wɔyɛ mberɛw;
Woara kora hɔn yie,
Fa W'ayamuyie dom hɛn nyina.

. Asodzi da mo do
Dɛ miyi Nyame ayɛw,
Megye me kra a onnwu da nkwa,
Na mema ɔsɛ sor.

. Mosom mbersantsen yi,
Midze dwuma a wɔahyɛ m',
Ao, nkyɛ medze m'ahom nyina
Maayɛ mo Wura Ne pɛ!

. Fa nhwɛyie bɔ me ban
Ma mentsena dɛ ihu m';
Na, mo Wura, siesie Wo somfo
Na meebu nkontaa pa.

. Gyefo, Ɔwo, dɔ ntsi
Iwui maa me,
Ɔmmfata dɛ medze,
Hweeara kam Wo;
Dɔm', me kra bɔkotow W',
M'akoma edzi ne nsew do,
Na ɔabɔ afɔr bi,
Ama W' sesei.

. Mbɔbɔr egua n' enyim
Idzi ma me,
Jesus, me gyedzi to
N'enyi hwɛ Wo:
Boa m' ma monsoa mbeamudua n',
Mombɔ Wo dɔ n' dawur,
Montow ndwom, mbɔ mpaa bi
Mma Wo sesei.

. Ma m' nokwar 'koma a,
Ɔsɛ Wodze N',
Na dabiara a otwam'
Eehu me dɛ
Mahyɛ dɔ dwuma bi ase,
Mayɛ ayamuyie bi,
Matwe kobɔnyi bi,
Medze ama W'.

. Nyan, soɛr, yɛ dɔ na edwuma,
Nnoma asoɛr rusu,
Bɔsu atɔ egu nhaban do,
Wiadze nyina asoɛr
Rihyira, Nkwa Wura Ne Mafo
Ɔhobrɛadzefo No.

. Bra, ma wo ndze mfora hɔn dzem',
Ka mu bi yi N' ayɛw;
Hwɛ mbrɛ ewia a ofir tsetse,
Asoɛr rehyerɛn dzendzen!
Dɛm na ma Jesus dɔ m'bɔsɔ
Gya wɔ w' akoma mu.

. Nyame asomfo, hom nsoɛr!
Hom n-tow nsɛmhun ngu!
Hom mfa 'koma, adwen, ndamyɛ
Mbɔsom ahemfo Hen!

. Nyame asomfo, hom nsoɛr!
N'ahendzi ekyim dodow;
Hom mma enuadɔ nda edzi,
Na sum nye manso nkɔ.

. Yɛ ara, ɔnnkɛyɛ gyam bi,
Dza 'yew n' ha n', fa n' mfaso wɔ sor:
Nɛndze nnkamfo w', mmpɛ w', wommbu w' bi;
Owura pen wo; nyimpa nye bɛn?

. Yɛ ara, ber a kan wɔ do yi,
Wiadze edwumayɛ ber resa:
Mma nnyɛ akwadwerɛ, yɛ w'edwuma ntsɛm;
Wonnsi n' dɛm twe sunsum ekyir.

. Sum ruku nɛndze a wɔnye W' tse,
Dɛ wonnyi enyidar wɔ wum';
Ma gya no do, na ka n' kɛse,
Gya a ɔma mbrɛ sum wɔ yɛ kan n'.

. Yɛ ara, mma mberɛ, weɔn na sɔr,
Wɔdze nyansa twe kra ekyir;
Sir wiadze bra ne tsempɔn yim'
Pon akobɔfo ma wɔmbra.

. Kyerɛ m' kwan, Nyame Tumfo,
Ma mundu botae n' ho;
Mutu me nan a ɔnnyɛ,
Na Wo nna wɔdze Wo yɛ
Bɔ m'akɔndɔ mbeamuduam'
Na gye me pɛ fi me nsam'.

. Kyerɛ m'kwan, 'Hoɔdzen Farbaa,
'Nnyim' a meyɛ a, ɔnnyɛ da
Mbrɛ metse na dza mowɔ
Nnkotum dze m'aba Wo hɔ.
'Wo nye Sahen, mo Wura
'Mi, meyɛ akowaa koraa.

. Kyerɛ m' kwan, m' Egya Papa,
Na Wo som yɛ dɛw ampa.
Sɛ mennya Wo, mennhu Wo,
Mennhyia Wo, Nyame Dɔfo,
Ao, nkyɛ matɔ dɔnsuar koraa
Emi a me gyedzi suar.

. Ewuradze, Wo dzinm' na misim',
Mikedzi me daa daa dwuma,
Wo nko na mesua dɛ m'bɔhwɛ W'
Wɔ dza modwen, meka, meyɛm'.

. Edwuma a Wo nyansaa akyerɛ n'
Ao, ma mempra mo mu nyina nyɛ,
Munhu Wo mo ndwuma nyinam',
Na menyɛ Wo pɛ a ɔsɛ n'.

. Ma memfa Wo ngyina me nyimfa,
'Wo a W'enyi tua mo mu nyina,
Na mindzi dwuma a ebɛkyerɛ m',
Muntu mo ndwuma nyina nhyɛ Wo nsa.

. Ma monsoa Wo kɔndua harhar n'
Na ber biara mohweɔn, monsɔr,
Na monhwɛ bɛkyebo ndzɛmba,
Nyɛ ntsɛm ndu W'enyimnyam da n' mu.

. Ao, mo Wura, ma menye W' nnantsew
Som dwumadzi mbrɛadze kwan mu;
Kyerɛ m' W'esumasɛm, boa m' ma monsɔw,
Dwumadzi ne yaw, dadwen no dur;
Boa me ma memfa dɔ kasa
Mpuhim akoma nyaanyaa bi:
Kyerɛ me ma mingya akobɔfo,
Memfa hɔn nsi sor kwan no mu.

. M'egya, minyim me bra nyina
Akyekyɛm' ama me,
Na nsakyer a otwar dɛ ɔba n'
Munnsuro dɛ m'bohu;
Dza meserɛ nye adwendahɔ a
Ɔper sɔ W'enyi daa.

. Meserɛ Wo adwendwen ɔdɔ a
Ɔyɛ aweɔn ho nyansa,
Dze ma ahomkafo enyigye,
Pata nyinsuwakyifo;
Ɔnye 'koma a ɔpow noho
Na ɔtse ma binom so.

. Monnhwehwɛ ɔpɛ ɔnnda hɔ komm,
Odzi akɔnaaba,
Ɔhwehwɛ akɛsedze ɔayɛ
Na oehu esumasɛm;
Mepɛ dɛ meyɛ abɔtoaba a
Woara gye me taataa.

. Wiadze mu mbrɛ m'bɛfa biara,
No mu dzibew biara,
Menye nkorɔfo edzi nkitaho a
Meper ara ma oeenyin,
Na medze ahobrɛadze nye dɔ
Mayɛ Mo Wura edwuma.

. Hom a hom enyi tsim
Zion kwan do, hom mbra,
Wɔmma yɛnyɛ kor nyi
Hɛn Wura No ayɛw;
Wɔmma yentu ntsen Jesus mu
Nkɛpem dɛ yebopue N'enyim.

. Mber nyina yɛda ho
Tow kɔ hɛn man no ho,
Kɔ sor kokwaa no ho
Kwantunyi fonafo fie;
Sor Jerusalem fofor no
Ɔdomankoma dɔ fie no.

. Ma daa nyina yennya
Gyedzi ho asomdwee,
Dɛ woeyi hɛn efi
Bɔn, wiadze, wu, na hɛllm';
Hɛn yɛbɔkɔ hɛn Egya fie,
Hɔ yeekehyia hɛn Nua panyin n'.

. Bethel Nyame, 'Wo a Wo nkorɔfo
Dan Wo na wonya dzi;
Ɔwò a igyaa tsetse mpanyin
Hɔn akwantu nyinam'.

. Yɛdze nsewdzi na mpaabɔ ba
W'adom ahengua enyim;
Hɛn egyaam Nyame, yɛserɛ Wo, yɛ
Hɔn mba so hɛn Nyame.

. Ɔbra n'akwan nyinara mu
Gye hɛn anamɔn taataa;
Ma hɛn hɛn daadaa edziban
Na hɛn efuradze so.

. O trɛ W'atsaban wɔ hɛn do
Kɔ hɛn akwantu ewiei,
Na hɛn akra eetum edu
Hɛn Egya fie asomdweem'.

. Agyedzifo hɔn Kwankyerɛfo a
lgya sor akwantufo kwan,
Bra na enye hɛn so mbɛtsena,
Yɛpɛ yɛatwer Wo nkotonoo,
Dze hɛn sunsum adan Wo nko
Ber a yɛnam ɔbra kwan mu.

. Ahɔho nye amamforafo,
Wiadze ha ɔnnyɛ hɛn tsenabew;
Na yetwa mbusu bɔnsa yim',
Yɛper dɛ yebohu W'enyim,
Yɛpɛ ntsɛm yeedu hɛn kurom',
Hɛn domakoma fie wɔ sor.

. Yennyi mantsimadze wɔ ha,
Yɛhwɛ kurow a wonnhu no kwan;
Yɛhom do nantsew kɔ noho,
Yereper yeedu kan mbew no do,k
Jerusalem kurow krɔnkrɔn a ɔ
Tsease Nyame ɔkyekyeree n'.

. Yɛdze abotar tu empire n',
Yegya fona wiadze 'i ekyir:
Fi ahoɔdzenm' kɔ ahoɔdzenm',
Hwehwɛ Jerusalem fofor n';
Hɛn mbɔdzembɔ nyina nye dɛ,
Yenya Jerusalem fofor n'.

. 'Wo a asoa hɛn bɔn nyina kɔ,
Na adom hɛn bɔnfakyɛ kwa,
Yɛnam Wo do kɔ hɛn sor fie,
Yɛdze adwontow yɛsan Zion;
Hɛn 'nyimnyam Hen N'ahenkurow no,
Yɛrotow ndwom nna ɔrebɛn hɛn.

. Gya hɛn, ɔsor Egya, gya hɛn
Wɔ wiadze po pramee do,
Gya hɛn, weɔn hɛn, kora hɛn, nyɛn hɛn,
Yennyi boafo dɛ Wo nko,
Naaso yɛwɔ nhyira nyinak
Sɛ Nyame ne hɛn Egya a.

. Gya m', Kan dɔyɛfo wɔ sum a etwa ehyia yim'
Gya m' ara kɔ!
'Nago n' yɛ sum, menye fie ntam' so war;
Gya m' ara kɔ!
Weɔn m'anamɔn, mimmbisa dɛ munhu
Mbrɛ kan hɔ tse, namɔn kor ara ma m'.

. Nkyɛ menntse dɛm, monnsɔɔr pɛn dɛ Woara
Gya m' ara kɔ.
Nkyɛ mefa mo kwan, na muhum', afei
Woara gya m' ara kɔ!
Modɔɔ apɔmpɔmpɛ, na musuro mpo a,
Ntsɛn hyɛɛ me ma, mma nnkaa mfe a-etwam' kɔ.

. Bue nsunyiwa hyɛnhyɛnn n' sesei,
Mbrɛ yarsa nsu fi pem no;
Ma ogya na mununkum fadum
Ngya m' m'akwantu nyina mu:
Gyefo tumfo!
Yɛ mo mboa na me kyɛm daa.

. O adom Hen, fi sor ahengua n' do
Fa dɔ hwɛ na tsie hɛn mbɔbɔr su.

. Hwɛfo pà a edze bɔgya tɔɔ Wo nguan,
Kora Wo nguankuw a wɔnnkyɛr kwan fom.

. O Pomfo pa, Wo wu mu na agye hɛn:
Ma abɔn awerɛhofo daa nkwa.

. Sor Edziban, yɛdze Wo nyɛn hɛnho:
Pin bɔboa hɛn akra hɛn hia ber mu.

. Apatasu, ndzebɔnyɛfo Dɔfo,
Edɛw na siar nsunyiwa a ɔnnsa da.

. Ao, fa sor adom kyekye hɛn werɛ;
Yi W'enyim fɛɛfɛw n' enyimnyam kyerɛ.

. Adzekyeem' mununkum, adzesaam' ogya,
Bɛn hɛn na dan hɛn sum ma ɔnyɛ kan.

. Nye hɛn nnantsew, nye hɛn kwan daa daa,
Hɛn nkwam' na wum' Werɛkyekyer, Tum, Gyafo.

. DZEBƆNYƐNYI kɔbesae a mahaw,
Ɔdomankoma, mma nnto me seraha.
Ɔbra n'ehum rutu, kwanm' ayɛ kɔnn,
Ɔkra no Kwangyafo, gya m' kodu sɔnn.

. Gya m' kodu fie, me kra no korabew,
Mbrɛ ankonam bɔbɔfo biara nnyew.
Me bra n'ewiei to m' a, Onyankopɔn,
Samanadze Kanea, gya m' kodu sɔnn.

. Sum mu etumfo pii risi me mpa,
Woetwa ayer m'; minnya beebi memfa;
Naaso ber a medan Wo Nyame dɔ n',
M'adɔntsenhen tumfo! gya m' kodu sɔnn.

. Ebufuw da! Ao, nyinsuwa da!
Dza nkɔnhyɛfo kae n' abam',
Sor nye asaase rotɔ nso.

. Akomatu a ogura nyimpa,
Ber a Tsɛmbuafo n' fi sor besian,
Ɔno a ɔka a, obi nnka bi.

. Totorobɛnto ndze huhu,
Ɔgyegye ndakamaa nyinam'
Rotwe dɔm nyina kɔ asɛndzii.

. Wɔatsea Wu, wiadze rowosow,
Abɔdze nyina rinyanyan,
Eyi ano akyerɛ Tsɛmbuafo n'.

. Hwɛ, bukuu no mu nsɛm si pi,
Wɔ dza wɔakyerɛw n' mu nyina ho,
Ɔno na wɔdze bobu atsɛn.

. Sɛ Tsɛmbuafo n' tsena N'eguam'
Na esumasɛm biara da edzi a,
Obiara nnkɛfa noho gyan.

. Emidze m'beyi m'ano dɛn?
Woana no obotwitwa agye m'
Ber a anokwafo mpo hia adom?

. Hen a W'ahentum krɔn mbordo,
Ɔwo a ebɔ werdam ma hɛn,
Tsema Wura, pinkyɛn hɛn ɛ.

. Ɔtsɛmbuafo tseneenyi,
Dom hɛn brafi ho bɔnfakyɛ,
Ansaana werdzi da n' aso.

. Egyee ɔbaa dzebɔnyɛnyi n',
Edze wifo n' no bɔn kyɛɛ no,
Mo so ama menya enyidar.

. Me mpaabɔ na mo mbɔɔ nnsɛ hwee,
Naaso, Nyame, kyerɛ W'adom
Na gye m' fi onnyiewiei gya n' mu.

. Ao, fa me ka Wo nguantsen n' ho,
Mma mmpem m' adze nnka mberɛkyi n' ho,
Mbom ma m' do si W'abanyimfa.

. Mewu o! Su na ewuotwa da n' a!
Nyimpa fi huntumam' reba n' a,
Onsiesie noho mma atsɛmbu.

. Ewuradze, ɔnnyɛ 'mi m'asɛm
Muwu anaa metse ase o;
M'afamudze nye m'bɔdɔ W', masom W'
Yi gyedɛ W'adom ma.

. Sɛ nkwa war a, m' enyi bɛgye
Ama maasom Wo akyɛr,
Tsia so a, bɛn ntsi na m'bedzi mbɔɔ
Dɛ m'botu akɔ onnyiewieim'?

. Christ ɔmmfa m' ndua mbrɛ hɔ yɛ sum
Sen mbrɛ Noara koduae n';
Nyia ɔba Nyame ahenman mu n'
Gyedɛ ɔfa abow yim'.

. Bra, Mo Wura, sɛ adom ma mesɛ
Dɛ muhu W'enyim a;
Na W'asaase edwuma yɛ dɛw a,
W'enyimnyam bɛyɛ dɛ dɛn?

. Na m'botwa mo suhuhun do,
Na fona na bɔn ndafua,
Makɔdɔm esiarfo a wɔtow
Jehovah N'ayɛyi.

. Man bi wɔ hɔ a dɛw mapa wɔm',
Ahotsewfo dzim' hen;
Adzekyee nko, adze nnsa da,
Hɔ enyigye tu yaw.

. Hɔ na nhaban wuna dabaa.
Na hɔ nhiren nnyam da;
Wu tse dɛ po tseabaa a, otwa
Sorman na hɛndze yi ntamu.

. Nhaban huanhuam wɔ esuegya hɔ
Woewuna dukuduku;
Dɛm na Jewfo hun Canaan ma n'
Dɛ Jordan pem twa ntamu.

. Na adasa suro bɔ piriw dɛ
Wobotwa po tseabaa n',
Wɔbɔ ngyangyan wɔ esukɔn do,
Wosuro dɛ wobepia.

. Ao, nkyɛ yeeyi ekyingye akwa,
Na adwen kusukusu n',

. Jesus na odzii kan
Dze hɛn akoma bɔɔm';
Hɛn a yɛnye N' nantsew fufuwn'
Ɔma yɛka koryɛm'.

. O wɔmma yɛnkɔ do
Wɔ Jesus N'edwumam';
Asɔr ne Tsir konyimdzifo n',
Yɛnka No do ndzi nyim.

. Christ no wenyin ture n'
Saw n'edwumafo enyim;
Na hwɛ! akatua kɛse no
Da sor hɔ rotweɔn hɛn.

. O hɛn 'koma nye adwen
N-da ho ara mfow sor,
Nkɔhwɛ hɛn ahomgye bea no,
Mbrɛ hɛn fona bɔ adze.

. Hɔ dwumadzen nyina,
Nye amandzehu nye yaw
Wotwa do wɔ siar mpoano hɔ;
Hɔ yehyia a yɛmmpaam' bio.

. Ahomka bea dɛɛdɛw,
Hɔ na abɔfo hyia hɛn,
Hɔ yebohu hɛn enyim bio,
Na yeekyiakyia hɛnho.

. Abakamfo Asɔr,
Hɔn nhyira n' yebenya,
Na yɛdze dɛw ayɛ abɔtsir
Yɛakɔ sor ahomgyem'.

. Christ a nhyira nyina fir Wo,
Ema ahosewfo dzi mu,
Tsie hɛn a Wo su sɛ hɛn,
Yɛyɛ Wo honam nwanwa n'.

. Ka hɛn ho wɔ sunsum korm',
Ma yɛnda ho nya Wodze n';
Yɛba bebisa mbordo,
Ɔwo a ehyɛ adze nyina ma.

. Kenyan, nunu na gya hɛn
Kyɛn ankorankor akyɛdze,
Wɔahyehyɛ n' dɛ mbrɛ epɛ,
Ma hɛn ndwuma nyina nhyɛ ma.

. Dɛw mu ara yɛnyɛ kor
Yennya tsema mma hɛnto:
Na yɛmboa hɛnho nkorkor;
Obiara nyɛ n'afamudze.

. Jesus, 'nye W' Asɔr ntsena,
Yɛ n' Agyenkwa, Wura, Gyafo;
Wɔrosɔ ne gyedzi ahwɛ n',
Yɛserɛ Wo, tsie hɛn.

. Tsew ne bra na nkyerɛkyerɛ ho;
Dom n' abotar ma ɔnsɔw
Na ɔntwer W' anohoba n',
Yɛserɛ Wo, tsie hɛn.

. Ongya ehiafo na efurafo,
Nda ho nhwehwɛ dza ayew n',
Ɔnkyekyer 'koma bobɔe,
Yɛserɛ Wo, tsie hɛn.

. No nokwar kanea n' nhyerɛn;
Ɔmma ne kan n' do wɔ sor
Wɔ abosom-man sum mu.
Yɛserɛ Wo, tsie hɛn.

. Guanhwɛfo pa, dom hɛn Wo mboa
Wɔ hɛn mbusu nda yim',
Tum a wɔdze weɔn, wɔdze sɔr,
Fa ma Wo mba nyina.

. Ber a yɛda ho da nsɔhwɛm',
Ber a yɛso mbeamudua 'i,
Ma yɛmfa hɛn kra nto Wo do
Wɔ mpaabɔ a ɔmmbɔ adzem'.

. Ma yendua gyedzim' hɛn nsa nka
M-paabɔ sunsum no;
Yemmia ndzi ako gyedɛ yehu
W' enyim nye Wo dzin pa n'.

. Ma 'koma biara nsu nka dɛ:
Minnkegyaa Wo ma akɔ,
Gyedɛ ama m' dɔ a odzi mu,
Na edze Woho akyɛ m'.

. Minnkegyaa Wo ma akɔ gyedɛ
Ebɔ Wo dzin kyerɛ m',
Na egye me kra nkwa nwionn nwionn,
Ma meyɛ dɛ Ɔwo.

. Kenyan W' edwuma yi,
Ewuradze, kyerɛ Wo tum;
Bɔ Wo ndze a onyan ewufom',
Na ma Wo nkorɔfo ntse.
Kenyan W' edwuma yi,
Ber a yɛkotow Wo yi,
Sian, ao Ewuradze domfo, sian!
Bra behyira hɛn sesei.

. Kenyan W' edwuma yi,
Ma akra nhwehwɛ nkwa-su n':
O ma hɛn esunsum kɔn ndɔ
N-kwa edziban no!

. Kenyan W' edwuma yi,
Krɔn W' enyimnyam dzin no;
Wo sunsum mma hɛn dɔ m-fram
Mma W' nye Wo mba nyina.

. Kenyan W' edwuma yi,
Ma W' asɛm no nnya tum;
Ma wɔmfa enyikan gyedzi ntsie
W' asɛmpa a nhyira wɔm' n'.

. Ahomka da ɔnye da n' a
Medze moho maa m' Agyenkwa!
Ɔsɛ dɛ mo 'koma dzi dɛw
Na ɔka ne dɛw kyerɛ aman.
Ahomka da! ahomka da!
Da a Jesus hoor mo ho bɔn nyina
Ɔkyerɛɛ m' dɛ monweɔn na monsɔr
Na mindzi dɛw aber nyina
Ahomka da! ahomka da!
Da a Jesus hoor mo ho bɔn nyina!

. Siar n-hyehyɛɛ! ɔsɔw nsew a
Midzii kyerɛɛ mo Dɔfo n' ano!
Ber a meba N' asɔrfim' yi,
Wɔmma ayɛyindwom nhyɛ hɔ ma.

. Ahyɛmu kɛse no yeewie dzi!
Mo Wura dze nye m', No so yɛ medze;
Ɔtwetwee m' ma mekaa No do,
Ne Nyame ndze n' ɔyɛ me dɛw.

. M' akoma a ekyima akyɛr
Bɔhom wɔ ahomka bea ha:
Mma mmfi w' Ewuradze nkyɛn da
Afa N' a, afa siar nyina.

. Hwɛ mbrɛ Israel Guanhwɛfo
Esi dze dɔ gyina hɔ;
Tsie! ɔrefrɛ m- bɔtoaba,
Ɔreyɛ hɔn etuu.

. Ɔse, Hom ngyaa hɔn ma wɔmbra,
Mma hom mmbu hɔn 'nyimtsia!
Osian akra yinom n-tsi
Na Ewuradze bae.

. Ɔkofo, soɛr gyina,
Suo Christ mbeamudua n' mu;
Fa wo Pomfo dzin ka ntam dɛ
Apow wiadze ndzɛmba

. Soɛr ma wonnuma wo-
Wɔnhor wo ho bɔn nyina;
'Nye wo Nyankopɔn ndzi ahyɛmu,
Ndɛ to wo gyedzi dzin.

. Ndɛ Christ akowaa nye wo
Wɔkan wo fora esiarfo n',
Ndɛ edɔm tsetse nkɔnhyɛfo n',
Na asomafo n' na atɔfo n'.

. Ma Nyame akodze nyina
Nhyɛ w' dzen; 'nye abɔnsam nko:
Ɔsa n' bɛyɛ dzen, ɔbɛkyɛr,
Na otwar dɛ yedzi nyim.

. Ewuradze Krɔnkrɔn, memmfata
Dɛ 'Wo 'bɛba mo hɔ,
Kasa ara: ka adomsɛm kor,
Na me kra ho bɛsan.

. Memmfata: me kra mu tsenabew
Yɛ nwinwin, yɛ nkɔnkɔw;
Ebɛyɛ dɛn ahɛn mu hɔ?
Kasa, na m'bɛtse apɔw.

. Memmfata dze; na m'bɛyɛ dɛn
Mesiw me Nyame kwan?
Ɔwo a Wo honam nye bɔgyaa
Edze tɔɔ nkwa maa me.

. Afei hɛn Egya yɛrekaa Wo dɔ n',
Dɔ a ɔtɔɔ hɛn prɛko wɔ mbeamudua n' do n';
Na hɛn sor Dzimafo n' so wɔ ha yi,
Yɛtrɛ hɛn afɔrbɔdze mu ma Wo,
Afɔrbɔdze a no nko fata W'enyim,
Jesus, nokwar afɔrbɔdze a otsim.

. Agyenkwa no dɔ ho nkaa ntsi
Na yɛaba pon yi ho:
Ha na Jesus to nsa dze frɛ
Hɔn a woenu hɔnho.

. Yɛnam gyedzim' fa nkwa paano
Yɛdze nyɛn hɛn akra;
Yɛnom wenyin dze kaa bɔgya a
Ogui maa abɔn no.

. Dɛ mbrɛ W'adom Asɛm no tse,
Ahobrɛadzem' ara
Yi na m'bɛyɛ, m'Ewuradze a
'Ruwu, mebɛkaa Wo.

. Wo honam a 'mi ntsi wobui n'
Bɛyɛ mo sor paanoo;
W'ahyɛmudze kuraba n' na megye,
Ma medze makaa Wo.

. Sɛ medan m'enyi hwɛ mbeamudua n'
Na mohom Calvary hɔ a
Nyame Egumba e, m'afɔrdze e,
Otwar dɛ mekaa Wo.

. M'bɛkaa W' ɔnnye Wo fona nyina,
Nye Wo dɔ a adɔ m' nyina
Nyew ber a ahom kakra wɔ hɔ 'i
M'bɛda ho ara makaa W'.

. Ma yenhu W' ber a yeridzidzi,
Na mma nn-dan hɛn nngya;
Agyenkwa, nye hɛn ntsena, na to
Wo pon hɛn 'koma mu.

. Sor paano a enyɛn me,
'Wo 'yɛ edziban ampa:
Ma nokwar nkwa paano yi
Nyɛn me kra daa daa nyina;
Ɔwo a iwui na etse ase,
Minnya Wo mu ahoɔdzen daa.

. O Ewuradze, ha na muhu W'enyim,
Ha na mepɛ mesuo dza wonnhu mu;
Morohwehwɛ menya Nyame N'adom,
Na medze me berɛ mato Wo do.

. Ha na m'bedzi Onyame edziban,
Na menye Wo anom ɔsor wenyin;
Na medze m'adzesoa mato n-kyɛn
Na makaa Wo fakyɛ ne dɛw no bio.

. Edzidzi na adwontow aber nye yi,
Ɔsor pon na wɔato ama me yi.
Ma menye Wo mbɔ mu yendzidzi ha,
Na enye me ndzi nkitaho dɛɛdɛw.

. Ɔnnkyɛr na wɔakata nsɛnkyerɛdze n' do:
Aponto n' etwam'; dɔ no dze nntwam' da.
Woyi paano na wenyin no kɔ mpo a
'Wo, hɛn Kyɛm na Ewia, ebɛn hɛn daa.

. Minnyi mboa bi dɛ Wo nko Wodze no,
Na onnhia mpo dɛ motwer obi so.
M'Ewuradze, Woara dɔɔ so ma me,
Wo tum n-ko ara nye m'ahoɔdzen.

. Christ abɔ werdam apon hɛn,
No ho nkaabɔdze na yɛyɛ yi;
Yɛkyerɛ hɛn Wura No wu kɛpem
Da a ɔbɛba.

. No honam a wobui maa hɛn
Wɔ nkaabɔ paano yi mu ha,
Ɔno na ɔnyɛn hɛn dɔ kɛpem
Da a ɔbɛba.

. Bɔgya a oruwu a okyii no
Wenyin yi yɛ ho sɛnkyerɛdze.
Yɛbɔnom ara akɛpem
Da a ɔbɛba.

. Anago bɔn a wonyii N' mae n'
Na Ne mbae a odzi ekyir no
Yɛdze dɔ nyɛbea bɔm' kɛpem
Da a ɔbɛba.

. N-dze a wɔtsee wɔ Eden
Ayerhyia kan n-dze n',
Asɔpɔn awar nhyira n'
Ɔda ho ara wɔ hɔ.

. Christian ɔbaa na barimba
So rokɔ awar a,
Nyame Ɔkorsa wɔm' bi,
Na yɛserɛ Ne nhyira:

. Dɛ ɔndom hɔn m-ba pa,
Nye dɔ na nokwardzi,
Na ɔndom hɔn koryɛ bi a
Biribiara nntum mmpa mu.

. Sor Egya, Woara bɛfa,
Ayefor yi ma awar,
Dɛ mbrɛ 'dze Eve maa Adam,
Fii noara ne mfem' no.

. Agyenkwa domfo, bra na
Bɛka hɔn bɔm' ɔdɔm',
Dɛ mbrɛ edze su ebien
Bɔɔm' wɔ Woara Wo mu n'

. Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn, behyira hɔn,
Ber a wɔrobɔ mpaa yi,
Dɛ mbrɛ ehyira Christ N'Asɔr
Ma ɔyɛ N'Ayefor n'.

. Tserɛw W'atsaban wɔ hɔn do,
Pa hɔn mbusu nyina,-
Ber a worutu anamɔn
Ba W'afɔrmbukyia ho,

. Egya, adze nyina Yɛfo,
Wo nyansaa, tum na dɔ
Dzii kan dze akra ebien bɔɔm'
Wɔ Eden ture mu;
N-dɛ fa nkan n' akyɛdze n'
Ma Wo mbofra yi so,
Ofi a W'asomdwee wɔ mu,
Ɔdɔ a nokwardzi wɔm'.

. Gyefo a ekɔr Galilee
Ayeforase hɔ,
N-dɛ so fa enyimpa ma
Hɔn a wɔfrɛ Wo yi:
Ma hɔn wiadze enyigye
Ɔndan sor enyingye
Na wɔsɔ hwɛ a, ma wonhu
Dɛ Woara W'akyɛdze a.

. O Nyame Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn,
Ɔwo a Wo dɔ yɛ dzen,
W'ahotsewee so dzi mu,
Fi sor gu hɔn do ahom,
Ama Woara wowaw hɔn
Fi ntokwaa ho n-tsi,
Hɔn bra aakyerɛ dɛ 'Wo na
Ehyɛ hɔn 'koma do.

. YƐBƆ Wὸ ewuo, Domfo Nyame Ɔkorsa,
Nana Adam na Evѐ hɔn hyiafo kor!
Fa Wo Nyame suro, ɔdɔ, nye nyansa
Behyira Okumfor na Ayefor.

. Ehumbɔbɔr, kyɛw nyѐ yi, dom hɔn awarsɔ,
Wɔ bra n'atseetsee gyatanaa mpo mu;
Ndafua nyinara mu ɔsor enyisɔ
Nyɛ hɔn kyɛpɛn ber a hɔn nkwa wɔw do

. Sɛ yaw to hɔn, wɔka n' fabi a ɔmmbà a,
Ɔbra n'ehum Taafo, pa hɔn esian;
Weɔn hɔn, na ma wɔmfa enyi ntsim Wo do,
Mbɛgye akatua pà a ofi nkodzen

. SUNSUM Krɔnkrɔn, tsena hɛn kra mu,
Na ma Wo gya mfi sor nhyerɛn;
Edze sunsum ngo sera hɛn,
Na ema akyɛdze horow.

. W'adom ngohuam a ofi sor
Yɛ awerɛkyekyer, nkwa na dɔ;
Na Wo kan a onndum da no
Nhyerɛn hɛn do, ɔmpa hɛn sum.

. Ewuradze, kasa kyerɛ me,
Ma munsusu Wo do nkasa;
Ahwehwɛ me yi ma mo so
Monhwehwɛ Wo mba a wɔayew no.

. Mo Wura, gya me kwan ma mo so
Mingya W'akobɔfo taataa;
O nyɛn me ma mo so memfa
Manna mma hɔn a kɔm dze hɔn.

. O hyɛ me dzen ama ber a
Migyina pintsinn wɔ Wo mu n',
Maatsen me nsa ama hɔn a
Woridzi aper wɔ bra po do.

. Kyerɛkyerɛ m' na meetum makyerɛ
N-dzɛmba pa a ada n' edzi;
Ma m'anosɛm n-hwira ndu
Akoma pii ase noho.

. Fa W'asomdwee dɛɛdɛw n' ma me,
Ma minnya nyansa memfa nka
Asomdwee nsɛm nkyerɛ Wo mba
Asonafo wɔ mbusu mber mu.

. Mo Wura, fa Wo mayɛ no ma m',
Kodu dɛ m'akoma bu do,
Ma memfa ndam mombɔ dawur,
Menka Wo dɔ, minyi W' ayɛw.

. EWURADZE, hyerɛn hɛn do,
Ɔwo, adasamba Kan;
Dua Wo kyerɛwsɛm do
Yi Woho kyerɛ hɛn ndɛ;
Na yɛhwɛ W'enyim a
Hɛn akoma dzɛw ntsi
Nkɔkowaba nam hɛn do
Eesua W'adom nwanwa n'.

. Ewuradze, hue Sunsum
Gyaframee n' gu hɛn do,
Ma yɛdze ano kor
Yaabɔ Wo dzin dawur.
Ma Wo mba aso pa,
Ma hɔn adwen ontsim,
Na hɔn nyina eehu
Ndzɛmba akɛse a ayɛ.

. Hɛn Wura, kasa ma hɛn,
Dza yɛka nyina mu,
Ma dza yɛkyerɛ nyɛ dɛ
Mbrɛ W'asɛm tse ara;
Ama nguambaa aatse
Hɔn Guanhwɛfo n' Ne ndze,
Na wɔaaka No do daa,
Na woeedzi No mu dɛw.

. N-dɔbaa Ewuradze, tsie
Wo nkowaa ehiafo hɛn su;
Tsie hɛn gyedzi mu mpaabɔ yi
Na dom hɛn dza yehia.

. Yɛtweɔn Wo mbɔbɔr mu;
Inyim hɛn hia nyina:
Ampa dɛ n-dɔbaa no so,
Na edwumafo no suar.

. Sakyer wobinom so
Na soma hɔm W'asɔr mu
Ma wɔnka Wo tum kasa no
Dɛ 'Wo nye hɔn wɔ hɔ

. Ma wɔnka W'asɛmpa a
Adom ahyɛ no ma n',
Wɔnkyerɛ dɛ 'Wo nye Ewuradze,
Adasamba Gyefo.

. Hɛn Wura, sɛ W'asɛm ntsi
Yedua n-kwasɛm n' a,
Wo tum nsa no gugu do yi
Aba no befifir.

. W'adom ne ndam ara
Na ɔbɛma ndɔbaa pii,
Na ɔadɔr agyedzifo a
Wɔtse ma W'enyimnyam.

. Nsɛmpa n' ne nhyira nsu n',
Ma ɔntɔ mma hɛn daa,
Ma tum a ɔsakyer akra n'
Ɔmbra W'asɔfoe do.

. O Twearammpon Nyame,
Ma W'ahendzi no mbra,
O Christ, ma W'abaw do
Bubu ɔbɔn no tum.

. W'ahendzi a asomdwee
Nye dɔ wɔ mu n' wɔ hen?
Dabɛn na enyitan
Bɔbɔ adze wɔ ha?

. W'anohoba n' wɔ hen
Dɛ mber bi rebɛba a
Akodzi nye brafun
Boguan efi W'enyim?

. Ewuradze yɛserɛ Wo,
Ma Woho do na bra
Wo tum kɛse no mu,
Na ma hɛn enyi ngye.

. Nyimpa mmbu Wo dzin bi,
Mbataku kyer Wo nguan;
Pii wɔyew Wo ho dɔ,
Wɔbɔ 'nyimguasebra.

. Wiadze ruwu; daa nyinara
Mpempem mpempem na wɔsen kɔ!
Christianfo, hom m-per ngye hɔn;
Hom nka Jesus nkyѐrɛ hɔn ntsɛntsɛm.

. Ahodze, ahoɔdzen, nyimdzee,
Nyew, hom n-kwa mpo hom mfa mma;
Hom Gyefo ayɛ bi ama hom!
Na 'bɛn na hom nnkɛyɛ ama N'?

. Wɔnkɔbɔ dawur wɔ mbea nyinara dɛ,
Asomdwee Hen n' oridzi Ne hen:
N'adzesoa yɛ har, na No som so yɛ dɛw;
Wonyi No ayɛw, ahemfo hɔn Ɔhen.
Jesus akofo atamfo n' gyina a,
Wɔnper ndzi nyim, ɔkogu yɛ mbusu;
Christ N'ahenman ntsi yɛsɔw ɔfona a,
No som yɛ dɛw, na owu yɛ mfaso.

. Jesus Ɔkatakyi no dɔm adehye,
Wɔnsoɛr ngyina ma adasa nnya nkwa;
Wɔnhwɛ mbrɛ Christ Ne dzin edua atahye,
Wɔ mbea nyina dɛ wiadze Agyenkwa.

. WƆMFÀ Asɛmpa n' nkɔ ekyirѐkyir,
Mbrɛ wɔnntsee Jesus Ne nka.
Wɔmpaam' dɛ No mu wɔ fafir,
Asomdwee, isiar na nkwa.
Wɔnka N' yie ma bahatɔfo
Wɔmfa dɛw nkamfo Ne dzin.
Na mber nyinara wɔmpaa mu
Nka dɛ, Jesus bedzi Hen.

. Wɔmfà enyigye nsi Asɛm n' do,
Wɔnka n' bɔkɔɔ ara dɛ:
Nyame Ba Jesus ebowu
Na wiadze enya nkwa ndɛ!
Obiara a ɔgye No dzi no
Obenya sor ahendzi n';
Na amanaman ntonton No
Nse dɛ, Jesus bedzi Hen.

. Hom ngyina, hom ngyina mma Jesus!
Mbeamudua ho nsordaafo;
Hom mma N'ahen-frankaa n' do;
Onnyi dɛ ofi nsa
Obedzi No dɔm kan fi
Konyimm' akɔ konyimm'
Kyerɛ wɔka atamfo nyina hyɛ
Ma Christ dzi hen ampa.

. Hom ngyina, hom ngyina mma Jesus!
Hom ntsie abɛn ne frɛ;
Hom nduom ɔko kɛse n' mu
Wɔ N'enyimnyam da yim'!
Mbarimba, afei hom nsom no
Mfa ntsia atamfo dɔm n'
Hom mfa ndam ngyina mbusu ano,
Hom ntutu dɔm nka dɔm.

. Hom ngyina, hom ngyina mma Jesus!
Hom ngyina N'ahoɔdzen nkom'
Honam abaw bɛpa hom;
Mma hom nntwer hombo da.
Hom nhyɛ Christian akontar,
Na hom nweɔn asɔryɛm',
Edwumayɛ mu o, mbusu mu o
Mma hom nntwa abrɔdɔ.

. Christian n-sordaafo,
Hom nduom akono!
Jesus Ne mbeamudua n'
Dzi hɛn enyim kan.
Hɛn Hen Christ etu sa
Roko tsia tamfo n',
Hom nduom n-seraban do,
Hom nhwɛ ne mfrankaa n'.
Christian n-sordaafo,
Hom nduom akono!
Jesus Ne mbeamudua n'
Dzi hɛn envim kan.

. Yɛma Ne frankaa n' do a,
Abɔnsam dɔm gu;
Dɛm a Christ akofo,
Hom nkedzi konyim!
Yɛbɔ se yi ayɛw a,
Hɛll fapem wosow;
Enuanom, hom ntow ndwom,
Hom mma hom ndze do.

. Nyame N'asɔr tse dɛ
Dɔm a wɔyɛ dzen:
Yɛnam ahotsewfo
Hɔn anamɔn mu.
Hɛn mu nnyi mpaapaamu,
Yɛyɛ adze kor.
Hɛn botae, hɛn nkyerɛkyerɛ
Hɛn dɔ nyina kor.

. Ahengua botutu,
Ahenman etwam',
Na Jesus N'asɔr dze
Betsim afebɔɔ;
Samanadze akoban
Runntum ahyɛ do:
Christ Noara na ɔkae,
N'asɛm so yɛ hɔ.

. Ma m' gyedzi ntsaban na muntu
Nkɔ fua n' mu hɔ nkɔhwɛ
Sor esiarfo hɔn dɛw kɛse n',

Hom mbrɛ sũ na mbusu nnyi,
W' akwantu ber no asa.
Da yie, da yie, Nyame mfa w' nsie,
Adzesaa ahyɛ sum, da yie!

. Twer Jesu N' abaw mu komm,
Nyame dɔ nkata wo do;
Sun W' Agyenkwa No bom' sɔnn,
Mbrɛ bɔn biara nnkɛhaw wo.
Da yie, da yie, Nyame mfa w' nsie,
Yebehyiam' afebɔɔ, da yie!

. Menka dɛn wѐrɛhonyi?
Owu edzi m' emim,
Hwɛ, ɔayɛ m' kyirpaanyi
Na ɔama awɔw dze m'
'Patasu Christ e! suo mo mu
Na gye m' dɔfo n' kra dwudwoodwo.

. Menkã dɛn hɛll gyantsia?
Munnhu mo dɔfo n' bio
Henfa na ɔkɔ ara?
Saana ne mber asõ.
'Patasu Christ e! suo mo mu
Na gye m' dɔfo n' kra dwudwoodwo.

. Menkã dɛn ankonam?
Saana nyimpa nnsɛ hwee-
ɔnye hɛn edzi mpaam'
N' akwantu abɔ adze.
'Patasu Christ e! suo mo mu
Na gye m' dɔfo n' kra dwudwoodwo.

. Menkã dɛn enuanom?
Nyamesuronyi kɔ-
Tsema, ɔdwe, adom
Na dɔ, onyaa n' mbordo.
'Patasu Christ e! suo mo mu
Na gye m' dɔfo n' kra dwudwoodwo.

. Menka dɛn? mennka hwee,
Nyame ayɛ dza oye;
ɔbɛkyerɛ m' yi ase
Ndaamba wɔ N' ahemfie.
'Patasu Christ e! suo mo mu
Na gye m' dɔfo n' kra dwudwoodwo.

. Wɔntow ehurusi ndwom no,
Hom ndwom a ɔyɛ dɛw no;
Hom werɛ mfir hom yaw nyina,
Na hom nhue hom ayɛyi
Mma nyia oegya hom aba ha
Nye mfɛfo ebehyia mu,
Hɔn a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ hɛn
Mbrɛ wodua kɔ Jesus hɔ.
Wɔntow ndwom, wɔntow ndwom,
Dɛw na enyigye ndwom no,
Wɔntow ndwom, wɔntow ndwom,
Ahomka afe ndwom no.

. Binom dze ndwom nye mfrankaa baa
M-feda hɛn nhyiamu n' mù a,
Wɔrotow Hosanna ndɛ wɔ
Ɔsor mbrɛ abɔfo wɔ n';
Hɔ, Jesus N' enyimnyam mu hɔ,
Na wɔwɔ riyi N' ayɛw,
Nyame dɔ nsɛm dadaada n',
Ɔnye dza wɔtow no hɔ.

. Ahosɛpɛw da ato hɛn,
Nyame N' adom no dɔɔ sõ daa;
Ɔama siar ayɛ hɛn kyɛpɛn,
Yɛbɔtonton No daa daa daa.
Wonhur ndwom no, wɔmbɔm' kɛse,
Ahosɛpɛw afe n' aba,
Nyame Egya fata ndaase
Yɛbɔtonton No daa daa daa.

. Hɛn Wura Christ a nnsakyer da,
Twitwa gye hɛn Kwesida Skuul,
Kyerɛkyerɛ Wo mbofraba,
Wo a eyɛ Kwangyafo Kor.

. Ndaase, ndaase nka Ͻdᴐyɛfo
Ayɛyi, ayɛyi nka Twerammpon o!
Enyimnyam, enyimnyam nka hɛn Gyefo o!

. Oeyi m' sum mu ekesi kan mu.
Ͻsabarimba Katakyi,
Yegya Wo ekyir a ɔnnyɛ o!
